author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Former Nunavut premier keeps eye on northern infrastructure bid as trade war drags on
content:
As the trade war between the U.S. and Canada escalates, the sole Inuk sitting on Prime Minister Mark Carney’s Canada-U.S. trade advisory committee says he’s keeping his focus on federal funding for Arctic infrastructure.


“My focus remains on advancing nation‑building in the Arctic, diversifying our economy and supporting projects that are Indigenous‑led,” former Nunavut premier P.J. Akeeagok said in a short email about his contributions thus far on the Advisory Committee on Canada–U.S. Economic Relations. “I continue to raise the challenges we face, but more importantly, the opportunities ahead.”


There has been no talk of returning to the negotiation table since Canada walked from a joint-review of the Canada-United-States-Mexico agreement Aug. 20, saying U.S. leaders made unacceptable demands at the 11th hour.


U.S. President Donald Trump responded to the breakdown in talks with new tariffs, and Canada’s list of retaliatory tariffs went into effect Tuesday.


Since then, Trump has banned Canadian alcohol sales in the U.S., barred Canadian goods from U.S. government procurement contracts and has threatened to stop the sale of Bombardier jets in his country.


Nunatsiaq News requested an interview with Akeeagok to ask for his thoughts on how the ongoing dispute might impact the North, and to ask about what he’s advocated for thus far as a member of Carney’s Canada-U.S. trade advisory council.


He declined. 


Instead, he sent a statement saying he’s 

pleased to see that the federal government is investing $405 million toward the construction of Mackenzie Valley Highway in the Northwest Territories.


 The Mackenzie Valley Highway is the first project to receive funding thus far from Canada’s recently created Arctic Infrastructure Fund, aimed at boosting economic development and the Arctic’s access to domestic and global markets.


Akeeagok was

appointed

 to the advisory committee in April, alongside other ex-politicians and economic leaders

 in the banking, milk, steel and forestry industries.


He previously stated on social media that his focus on the committee is ensuring the Arctic remains “at the centre of Canada’s strategic investment agenda” and at the “forefront of nation-building.”


Meanwhile, other members of the advisory committee, such as Jean Charest, Erin O’Toole and Lisa Raitt, have appeared frequently on media programs to share their thoughts on the trade dispute.


Nunavut Premier John Main previously said the territory is in the process of accessing the impacts of the tariffs on residents and businesses. He wasn’t available for comment Thursday due to travel.


B2Gold, which owns Goose Gold Mine in the Kitikmeot Region, said in a statement in August that it doesn’t anticipate the new tariffs will have a direct impact on its operations in the territory.  


“Our operations rely on a broad supply chain for equipment, parts and consumables, including certain products sourced from the United States,” said Cherry DeGeer, a spokesperson for the company.

“We do not anticipate a material impact on our operations, but as the trade environment continues to evolve we will monitor developments closely.”


Renaud Brossard, vice-president of communications for the Montreal Economic Institute, a public policy think tank with offices across the country, said in an interview that the sooner Canada drops its retaliatory tariffs the better. 


“It’s essentially a tax increase at a time when businesses and consumers are feeling the pinch,” he said, mentioning the already high costs of food and other goods in the North. 


“By playing this tariff and counter tariff game we’re essentially making our economy a bit poorer and less competitive in the long run than we would be if we were to redouble on free trade instead,” he said, adding provinces still have a long way to go when it comes to removing barriers to internal trade.

author: Redazione_web
title: Bloccare il traffico di armi, costruire strutture di resistenza
content:
La vicenda


Nella serata del 24 agosto un Boeing C-17A Globemaster III della Kuwait Air Force, matricola KAF343, è atterrato all’aeroporto di Pisa. Mentre dalle immagini si deduce che l’aereo si trovasse lì per caricare o scaricare materiale compatibile con sistemi di artiglieria contraerea, dai tracciamenti pubblici è stato possibile ricostruire le diverse tratte effettuate dallo stesso velivolo nei giorni precedenti, attraverso scali di rilevanza militare in Kuwait, Italia, Stati Uniti e Regno Unito. Non è tuttavia possibile stabilire se tali voli facessero parte della stessa operazione o trasportassero il medesimo materiale.


Molti aspetti sono ancora da chiarire. Non si sa con certezza in quale parte dell’aeroporto si trovasse l’aereo (se la parte a uso civile o quella a uso militare), se stesse caricando o scaricando armi, e quale fosse la destinazione. Tuttavia, quel che appare chiaro è il coinvolgimento dell’Italia negli scenari di guerra globale e l’utilizzo di questo territorio della Toscana come hub logistico-militare, sempre più palesemente asservito agli interessi degli Stati Uniti e alle sue avventure belliche in Iran. In Kuwait gli Stati Uniti dispongono di importanti installazioni militari, mentre l’Italia opera ufficialmente nel Paese con un dispositivo dedicato alla difesa aerea e all’assistenza tecnica alla Kuwait Air Force. Pochi giorni dopo l’episodio di Pisa, gli Stati Uniti hanno nuovamente attaccato l’Iran. Non abbiamo elementi per collegare direttamente il volo transitato dall’aeroporto Galilei a quell’operazione, ma questo contesto rende ancora più urgente conoscere natura e finalità della movimentazione.


Non un caso, un sistema


Questa vicenda non rappresenta un caso isolato, ma l’ennesima prova del ruolo italiano nell’escalation bellica globale, ruolo che le istituzioni vorrebbero nascondere ma di cui la città viene a conoscenza solo grazie al lavoro di denuncia dal basso. Già nel marzo 2022 i lavoratori dell’aeroporto civile Galileo Galilei di Pisa avevano scoperto e denunciato insieme al sindacato USB un carico di armi destinate al conflitto in Ucraina, rifiutandosi di caricare l’aereo che ufficialmente avrebbe dovuto trasportare aiuti umanitari. Da quel momento, grazie ad un costante lavoro di monitoraggio e denuncia fatto dal basso, i movimenti di mezzi, carri armati, esplosivi, munizioni e truppe nell’hub militare che si sviluppa tra Pisa-Livorno-Piombino è uscito sempre più allo scoperto.


Dal Porto di Livorno e Piombino ai binari che collegano Pisa con Camp Darby, il trasporto di armi è divenuto centrale nell’organizzazione logistica della catena globale della guerra, tanto che in questi anni gli investimenti – sia italiani che statunitensi – per il rafforzamento infrastrutturale di queste arterie è cresciuto, con l’obiettivo di rendere le forze militari sempre più integrate e rapide. Ponti girevoli, rafforzamento del trasporto su rotaia (es. Tombolo, Pontedera), riqualificazione dei canali (è il caso del canale dei Navicelli che rappresenta la principale arteria di comunicazione via acqua tra Camp Darby e porto di Livorno), cementificazione della costa (Darsena Europa) e nuove banchine stanno trasformando irreversibilmente il territorio con il chiaro obiettivo di rendere efficienti al massimo le operazioni militari.


Quello che vediamo nel nostro territorio non è altro che il riflesso di quello che avviene su scala più ampia. Già nel 2022 l’Agenzia esecutiva della Commissione Europea CINEA aveva messo a disposizione 330 milioni di euro per progetti legati alla mobilità militare, mentre nel 2024 l’approvazione da parte dell’Unione Europa del Regolamento 2024/1679 ha ulteriormente istituzionalizzato e rafforzato il processo, già avviato negli anni precedenti, di adattamento dual use delle reti europee alle esigenze della mobilità militare.


Nel contesto italiano, Rete Ferroviaria Italiana (RFI) ha immediatamente recepito questa indicazione e nell’aprile 2024 ha sottoscritto un accordo di collaborazione con Leonardo per “realizzare un progetto condiviso nell’ambito della Military Mobility, un’iniziativa Ue finalizzata ad aumentare le capacità infrastrutturali e digitali esistenti, per assicurare la movimentazione di risorse militari, all’interno e all’esterno dell’Europa, anche con breve preavviso e su larga scala”.


Tutto questo non fa che confermare la strategicità delle infrastrutture in questa guerra globale che non potrebbe esistere senza la possibilità di organizzarsi …

author: Dr. Yvonne Würz
title: Elefantenhof Platschow: Elefanten zum Tanzen gezwungen
content:
Im Jahr 2020 breitete sich in den sozialen Medien ein neuer Trend aus: Die Jerusalema-Dance-Challenge. Während die Teilnahme an solchen Challenges für die meisten Teilnehmer Spaß bedeutet, missbrauchte der Elefantenhof Platschow seine

Elefanten

 zu Unterhaltungszwecken für den Auftritt auf Facebook. [1]


Doch auch darüber hinaus werden die Elefanten des Hofes immer wieder zur Unterhaltung in Tierschauen eingesetzt. Zuletzt war eines der Tiere vermutlich sogar Teil eines Livestreams. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über das Tierleid der Elefanten des Elefantenhofs Platschow.


Update vom 10. September 2026


Elefant in Livestream zur Schau gestellt


Streamer Jordan und Semih haben für ihren Livestream am 9. September 2026 einen Elefanten gemietet, der bei ihnen in ihrem winzigen Studio zu Besuch war. Der Elefant stammt vermutlich vom Elefantenhof Platschow. Neben Elefantenshows bietet der Hof seine Tiere auch für Veranstaltungen und Fotoshootings an.


In dem Video der Streamer ist der Elefant zusammen mit seinem Begleiter im Studio zu sehen. Das Tier wirkt angespannt und hat aufgrund der niedrigen Decke kaum Platz nach oben. Während der Aufnahme bewegt sich der Elefant immer wieder hin und her und dadurch wirkt es so, als würde er „tanzen“. Solche Bewegungen stellen bei dressierten Elefanten jedoch meist kein natürliches Verhalten dar. Sie werden den Tieren im Rahmen einer Dressur beigebracht. Sie werden dabei nicht selten unter Androhung von Gewalt zu Tricks gezwungen. Das ist für die Tiere mit viel Leid verbunden.


Wir kritisieren die Streamer sowie die Zirkusleute, die Elefanten zur Schau stellen.  Gerade bei einem jungen Millionenpublikum kann der Eindruck entstehen, dass es völlig normal sei, Wildtiere für Reichweite und Unterhaltung einzusetzen. Dadurch werden Tierleid und der kommerzielle Umgang mit Wildtieren verharmlost. Zudem fordern wir weiterhin ein Ende der Zirkushaltung, da die Tiere in Gefangenschaft leiden und nicht zu Unterhaltungszwecken missbraucht werden sollten.


Originalartikel vom 5. Januar 2021


Elefantenhof Platschow dressiert Elefanten für Aufmerksamkeit auf Social Media


Am 1. Januar 2021 veröffentlichte der stationäre

Zirkusbetrieb

 auf seinem Facebook-Kanal ein Video, in dem zu sehen ist, wie die Elefanten der Zirkusdompteurs-Familie Frankello „Tanz“-Kunststücke vorführen müssen.


Das gepostete Video verdeutlicht erneut die Rücksichtslosigkeit der Zirkusbranche gegenüber den natürlichen Bedürfnissen von Tieren. In Zirkussen werden Elefanten für fragwürdige und tierschutzwidrige Kunststücke missbraucht, um Geld mit ihnen zu verdienen oder um auf Social Media

Aufmerksamkeit und Likes

 zu bekommen. Doch was die Zuschauer als unterhaltsam wahrnehmen, bedeutet für die missbrauchten Tiere ein Leben voller Leid: Die

Dressur

 von Elefanten und anderen Wildtieren basiert immer auf Gewalt und Zwang. Der Missbrauch der sensiblen Rüsseltiere zu Unterhaltungszwecken steht auch im krassen Widerspruch zu der positiven und friedlichen Message des Songs Jerusalema und der Dance-Challenge.


Dompteursfamilie Frankello fiel bereits mehrmals mit Misshandlungen auf


Der Elefantenhof Platschow ist ein stationärer Zirkus, in dem zehn Elefanten und zahlreiche weitere Tiere, darunter beispielsweise Seelöwen und Kamele, den zahlenden Besuchern vorgeführt werden. Regelmäßig werden die Tiere von den Dompteuren zu Veranstaltungen transportiert, auf denen sie auftreten sollen: Neben Zirkusvorstellungen werden die Tiere dort immer wieder auch für „Events“ wie Fußballspiele, Tauziehen oder Schlittenfahrten mit den Elefanten missbraucht. [2] Beim Elefantenreiten werden die sensiblen Rüsseltiere gezwungen, Besucher auf ihrem Rücken zu tragen – eine tierquälerische und

gefährliche Attraktion

, die im Ausland von Reiseveranstaltern zum Schutz von Mensch und Tier zunehmend aus dem Angebot gestrichen wird.


Die Dompteursfamilie um

Sonni Frankello

 sorgte bereits mehrfach wegen Misshandlungen der Elefanten für Negativschlagzeilen: Anfang 2012 wurden die Tiere über 20 Stunden auf einem Transporter gehalten, nachdem schlechtes Wetter einen Auftritt in Norddeutschland verhinderte. Ein Jahr zuvor wurden Elefanten für eine Promotion-Tour in zehn Tagen in zehn Innenstädte transportiert. Im Jahr 2006 sollten die Tiere eigentlich im Rahmen eines Techno-Konzerts auftreten – dieser Auftritt wurde jedoch kurzfristig abgesagt, weil die Elefanten sonst einem extrem hohen Lärmpegel ausgesetzt worden wären.

title: Convicted Huntsman ‘Bloods’ A Young Child At The Flint & Denbigh Hunt
content:
At the beginning of this year the Hunt Saboteurs Association was sent some of the most disturbing images we have seen in over sixty years of campaigning against bloodsports.


They show a young child having their face smeared with the blood of a freshly slaughtered fox by huntsman Conall McGrath, then of the Flint & Denbigh Hunt who operate in North Wales.


On receiving the images, the HSA immediately forwarded them to the police but, many months on, we are not aware of any action being taken.


Conall McGrath holds a dead fox aloft as a small child approaches. Terrier men smile behind them, one is holding a terrier.


The practice shown in the images is known as ‘blooding’. Blooding is an initiation ritual practised by hunts which ‘celebrate’ a hunter’s first successful kill. Prince Harry wrote about being ‘blooded’ after stalking a stag as a 15 year old boy.


Blooding relies on the animal being freshly killed as – obviously – the blood needs to be wet. The images show a fox whose blood is still fresh. It is inconceivable that the fox in the image is anything other than a fox killed moments earlier by the hunt.


In the first image, McGrath can be seen holding the body of the fox and encouraging the hounds to attack it as the child approaches. Behind the child stand two grinning terrier men: Rob Smith Jnr on the left, and Joe Scillario on the right, holding a terrier.


In the second image, McGrath grabs the child’s hair with one hand and smears blood on their face with the other.


The photographs are believed to have been taken on the 17th January 2026. On this same date, hounds from the hunt were filmed out of control on the busy A55, footage which we published at the time. You can watch the video sent in by an

unsuspecting motorist here

.


To protect their welfare, the HSA is concealing the identity of the child.


McGrath smears the dead fox’s blood on the child’s face


Incredibly, McGrath was convicted of illegal hunting just a few months before the images were taken, when he was a whipper-in for the

Blackmore and Sparkford Vale Hunt

. This incident made national news when the hunt were caught on camera hunting and killing a fox by North Dorset Hunt Sabs.


McGrath was one of four men convicted for his role in illegal fox hunting at Pelsham Farm in December 2023.


An HSA spokesperson commented:


“Over twenty years on from the passing of the Hunting Act, these harrowing images show continued illegal hunting and the utter determination of today’s hunters to induct a new generation of vulnerable youngsters into their sick and criminal activities.


This week we have already highlighted safeguarding concerns in relation to a private school whose ‘Games Coach’ was recently convicted of illegal hunting, whilst pupils of the school were present.These failings are a direct result of a Hunting Act that is not fit for purpose – we need much stiffer penalties to deter the likes of McGrath.


Following the recent consultation on trail hunting the government must immediately follow through on its manifesto promise and come down hard on those who break the law and hunt wildlife with packs of dogs”.

Convicted Huntsman ‘Bloods’ A Young Child At The Flint & Denbigh Hunt

Hunt Saboteurs Association

title: Chris Packham Joins Woman Living In Pig Crate During 21-Day Stand Against Factory Farming
content:
Wildlife presenter and former RSPCA president Chris Packham joined Michelle Farnham inside a pig farrowing crate outside the National Gallery today, where she has been living for over a week to highlight suffering on British factory farms.

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham is living inside the crate 24 hours a day as part of a living art installation outside the National Gallery. She does not leave the crate at any point, day or night, from 1 to 22 September. [1]

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham is living inside the crate 24 hours a day as part of a living art installation outside the National Gallery. She does not leave the crate at any point, day or night, from 1 to 22 September. [1]

Farrowing crates are still used in approximately 92% of indoor pig production systems, confining more than 200,000 mother pigs each year [2] - but Animal Rising says the crates are just one part of a much wider problem, and is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040.

Farrowing crates are still used in approximately 92% of indoor pig production systems, confining more than 200,000 mother pigs each year [2] - but Animal Rising says the crates are just one part of a much wider problem, and is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040.

The action follows Animal Rising’s release of hidden-camera footage documenting the life of Luna, a mother pig kept in a farrowing crate on a Suffolk factory farm. Over 19,000 people have now signed a petition calling for her release to sanctuary. [3] [4]

The action follows Animal Rising’s release of hidden-camera footage documenting the life of Luna, a mother pig kept in a farrowing crate on a Suffolk factory farm. Over 19,000 people have now signed a petition calling for her release to sanctuary. [3] [4]

Chris Packham joined Michelle in the crate today (09/09/26) on her ninth consecutive day living inside behind its bars in Trafalgar Square.

Animal Rising is now calling on the government to commit to the end of factory farming by 2040, arguing the scale of suffering in intensive farming systems can no longer be ignored.

Visiting today, Chris Packham said:

Packham stepped down as president of the RSPCA in December 2024 following Animal Rising investigations into RSPCA Assured farms and slaughterhouses, saying he had seen “no meaningful change” in response to the findings. [5] [6]

Michelle Farnham has spent years examining conditions inside British animal farms. She studied Animal Management for two years and has since reviewed hundreds of hours of undercover footage recorded inside UK pig farms, working alongside veterinary and animal welfare law experts to assess conditions, including during Animal Rising’s investigations into RSPCA Assured farms and slaughterhouses.

Farrowing crates can confine mother pigs for four to five weeks at a time around giving birth and nursing their piglets, leaving them unable to turn around or take more than a step forward or back. Sows are put through this cycle repeatedly, returning to the crates with successive litters until they are eventually culled.

Animal Rising released its investigation into Luna’s life last week, after documenting her for a month on a factory farm in Suffolk. Hidden-camera footage narrated by Michelle shows Luna giving birth and nursing her piglets while confined inside a farrowing crate, unable to turn around or freely interact with her piglets. Animal Rising is calling for Luna to be released to a sanctuary home that has been offered to her, alongside its wider call for the Government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040.

Over 19,000 people have signed the petition since Luna’s story was released.

Michelle and Animal Rising spokespeople are available for interviews and comment at the crate outside the National Gallery. Please email press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691 to arrange.

author: Animal Rising Press
title: WOMAN TO SPEND 21 DAYS AND NIGHTS IN PIG FARROWING CRATE IN TRAFALGAR SQUARE
content:
This morning (01/09/26) Animal rights campaigner Michelle Farnham entered a pig farrowing crate outside the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square where she will remain for 21 days, as Animal Rising launches its campaign to end factory farming in Britain by 2040.

The action coincides with the release today of never-before-seen footage following a month in the life of Luna, a sow confined in a farrowing crate on a British factory farm. Animal Rising are calling for the release of Luna from Red Court Farm in Ipswich. [1]

For three weeks, Michelle will remain inside the crate day and night, experiencing a fraction of the confinement imposed on sows like Luna: pigs trapped in these crates are able to stand up and lie down, but are unable to turn around, causing intense physical and psychological suffering.

Journalists are invited to attend the installation in Trafalgar Square to interview and film Michelle inside the farrowing crate, as well as speak to Animal Rising spokespeople on location. Please contact press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691 to arrange interviews.

Michelle Farnham will spend 21 consecutive days and nights inside a farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square, as part of a new installation launching Animal Rising's End Factory Farming campaign, which is calling on the UK Government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040 and publish a roadmap for the transition. [2]

title: Pferdemarkt Bietigheim-Bissingen: Ponys geschlagen – PETA erstattet Anzeige
content:
Anfang September erhielten wir von PETA Deutschland schockierende Whistleblower-Aufnahmen vom Pferdemarkt in Bietigheim-Bissingen: Etliche Pferde wirken panisch und gestresst, teilweise werden Ponys geschlagen. Auf der Veranstaltung wurden unter anderem Pferde ausgestellt und für 

Vorführungen

 sowie zum Kinderreiten eingesetzt. Wir haben Anzeige erstattet. 


Erfahren Sie hier mehr über die Vorfälle und wie wir dagegen vorgehen. 


Bildmaterial dokumentiert Gewalt und sichtlich gestresste Ponys


Das Bildmaterial zeigt erschreckende Szenen: Mehrere Ponys wirken massiv gestresst. Wiederholt werden 

Tiere geschlagen

 – teilweise sogar ins empfindliche Gesicht. Ein Pony reißt sich los und rennt durch die Menschenmenge. Auf dem Videomaterial sind immer wieder gefährliche Situationen für Menschen und Tiere zu erkennen. 


PETA fordert Konsequenzen und erstattet Anzeige


Wir von PETA Deutschland haben auf Grundlage der Aufnahmen Anzeige beim zuständigen Veterinäramt erstattet. Wir fordern umgehende Konsequenzen für die auf den Videos zu sehenden Personen und für kommende geplante Veranstaltungen. 


„Einige von ihnen wurden geschlagen“ 


„Der Pferdemarkt war für die dort befindlichen Ponys eine klare Tierqualveranstaltung. Umgeben von lauter Musik, Menschenmassen, Trubel und Lautsprecherdurchsagen zeigten etliche Tiere deutliche Stresssignale und gerieten teils in Panik. Statt sensibel auf sie einzugehen, wurden einige von ihnen geschlagen. Dieser Umgang zeigt einmal mehr, wie viel in der oft romantisierten Pferdewelt schiefläuft. Wenn Menschen in aller Öffentlichkeit Pferde schlagen, dann will man nicht wissen, was hinter verschlossenen Türen passiert, wenn niemand hinsieht. Das muss Konsequenzen haben.“

Jana Hoger, Fachreferentin bei PETA Deutschland

 


Die Szenen vom Pferdemarkt Bietigheim-Bissingen zeigen, warum Pferde und Ponys nicht zur Unterhaltung auf Veranstaltungen eingesetzt werden sollten. Wir fordern die Verantwortlichen auf, Konsequenzen aus den Vorfällen zu ziehen und Tiere bei kommenden Veranstaltungen nicht länger solchen Situationen auszusetzen, sondern die Ausstellung und den Einsatz lebender Pferde fortan zu untersagen. 


Die Tiere werden zu Handlungen gezwungen, die sie nicht freiwillig ausüben würden.


Warum Pferdemärkte für Ponys eine Belastung sind


Pferde

 sind sensible Fluchttiere. Unbekannte Umgebungen, Menschenmengen, laute Musik, Lautsprecherdurchsagen und Gedränge können für die Tiere eine erhebliche Belastung darstellen. Auf Veranstaltungen wie Pferdemärkten kommen zahlreiche dieser Stressfaktoren oft gleichzeitig zusammen: 


Bereits der 

Transport zum Veranstaltungsort

 kann für Pferde mit erheblichem Stress verbunden sein.  


Hinzu kommen das 

Verladen

, lange 

Wartezeiten

, 

wechselnde Bezugspersonen

 und die 

ungewohnte Umgebung

. 


Bei Vorführungen und beim 

Ponyreiten

 können die Tiere der belastenden Situation zudem nicht selbstständig entkommen.  


Stress kann sich unter anderem durch 

Unruhe

, starkes 

Schwitzen

, 

Schreckhaftigkeit

 und 

Ausweichverhalten

 zeigen. 


Geraten Pferde in einer solchen Situation in Panik, besteht zudem 

Verletzungsgefahr

 für die Tiere und anwesende Menschen. Die Aufnahmen aus Bietigheim-Bissingen zeigen, wie ein Pony sich losreißt und durch die Menschenmenge rennt.


Pferde sind fühlende Lebewesen, keine Unterhaltungsobjekte 


Pferde sind soziale und sensible Lebewesen mit individuellen Bedürfnissen. Dennoch werden sie für menschliche Interessen ausgenutzt, beispielsweise zur Unterhaltung, im sogenannten 

Pferdesport

 oder für kommerzielle Zwecke. Immer wieder sprechen wir uns gegen den Missbrauch von Pferden als „Sportgeräte“ aus. Auch beim Ponyreiten auf Festen und Märkten werden die Tiere zur Unterhaltung von Besuchenden eingesetzt und müssen unter der lauten Umgebung leiden. 


Auch 

Zucht und Handel mit Pferden

 sind problematisch: Solange Tiere gezüchtet und verkauft werden, obwohl bereits zahlreiche Pferde ein neues Zuhause suchen, wird das bestehende Tierleid weiter begünstigt. Wir fordern daher ein Ende des kommerziellen Tierhandels und des Nachzüchtens von Tieren.

title: Amed’s concrete towers threaten its historic skyline and community life
content:
Amed (Diyarbakır) is rapidly losing a culture of urban life that developed over millennia within its city walls, courtyard houses and narrow streets. A city that has witnessed civilisations, wars, migrations and natural disasters over thousands of years is now overshadowed by concrete blocks rising into the sky and the social fragmentation they bring with them. The rapid spread of high-rise development in Amed in recent years is reshaping the city’s collective memory, social relations and skyline.


Amed historically had a horizontal urban culture. Basalt-stone houses with courtyards and gardens, streets where neighbours’ doors opened onto one another, and neighbourhood solidarity built around shared water sources were among its most distinctive features. The 1965 Development Plan, which allowed apartment construction outside the city walls, followed by regulations that provided a legal basis for multi-storey reinforced-concrete buildings even within the walled city, marked the first major rupture in this horizontal urban memory. Over time, outlying neighbourhoods such as Rêzan (Bağlar), Peyas (Kayapınar) and Bajarê Nû (Yenişehir) filled first with informal housing built by impoverished people migrating from rural areas, and later with rapidly expanding and largely uncontrolled apartment development.


The situation today has moved well beyond the construction of multi-storey housing. Towers, residential complexes and high-rise blocks integrated with shopping centres have risen across the city and are now visible from virtually every vantage point overlooking its historic centre. Amed’s ancient skyline is no longer defined by the bastions of its city walls, but by glass-fronted towers adorned with advertisements promising a “modern lifestyle”.


A city rebuilt under government-appointed trustees


Suriçi was undoubtedly the site of the most painful and symbolic manifestation of this transformation. The demolitions carried out by the state in the Alipaşa and Lalebey neighbourhoods following the 2015–2016 self-government resistance were subsequently turned into a reconstruction project under the banner of “urban transformation”, within a framework determined by the central government and the Housing Development Administration of Turkey (TOKI), disregarding the will of local residents and the objections of the elected local administration. The destruction of these neighbourhoods, which carried thousands of years of human history and cultural heritage, could not be justified on technical or urban-planning grounds.


The new housing built after the demolitions left many rights holders burdened with heavy debts. Architecturally, despite claims that the buildings reflected the “authentic fabric of Diyarbakır”, they became standardised and anonymous structures with no meaningful relationship to the city’s actual urban fabric. The underlying purpose of this process was to alter the demographic structure of Suriçi and remove its long-established residents from its historic neighbourhoods. This was not merely a question of urban planning, but directly a process of engineering memory and identity.


How does concrete destroy neighbourhood life?


One of the least discussed yet most destructive consequences of high-rise development is the breakdown it causes in social relations. In courtyard houses, neighbours’ doors once opened onto one another, children grew up together in the streets, and women sustained everyday forms of solidarity on rooftops and in courtyards. In gated high-rise complexes equipped with security cameras, neighbourly relations are increasingly reduced to little more than making eye contact in a lift. The concept of the “mahalle” (neighbourhood), cultivated in Amed over centuries as a sense of community built around shared sorrow, joy and resistance, is rapidly being eroded by the individualism of high-rise and gated living.


This fragmentation is not accidental. Social solidarity networks in Kurdish cities have historically sustained both cultural continuity and political resistance. Replacing neighbourhoods, streets and courtyards with an urban model made up of isolated and disconnected gated complexes also weakens these networks of solidarity, collective memory and the capacity for resistance. Every intervention in the physical fabric of a city is, in effect, an intervention in its social relations.


In whose name is the skyline changing?

author: Dominic Gutoman
title: Cagayan Valley activists deny terror financing raps, call for repeal of terror laws
content:
Former Kabataan Party-list Cagayan Valley regional coordinator Jhames Paredes in the protest in front of Department of Justice. Photo by Dominic Gutoman/Bulatlat.

MANILA – “Poor farmers do not have the capacity to fund terrorism. We are already poor. Where are we going to find the money?”

This is the lament of Renato Gameng, a farmer for 40 years and a leader of Danggayan Dagiti Mannalon iti Isabela (Dagami) for the past 15 years. For him, it is puzzling that he is being accused of violating the Terrorism Financing Prevention and Suppression Act (TFPSA). Ten more activists were also charged with the same case before the Department of Justice’s National Prosecution Service.

Under the banner of human rights group Karapatan, the Cagayan Valley activists, including Gameng, and other human rights defenders held a protest in front of the Supreme Court (SC) and DOJ to denounce the use of twin terror laws– Anti-Terrorism Act and TFPSA– against activists. They submitted a letter to Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, calling for the review and repeal of the twin terror laws.

“The Supreme Court, as the guardian of the Constitution and the final arbiter of constitutional rights, has the solemn duty to ensure that laws enacted in the name of national security do not become instruments for suppressing constitutionally protected dissent,” the letter stated, signed by victims of the twin terror laws.

Just last month, six activists in Cagayan Valley received subpoenas including Gameng. They are former Kabataan Party-list Cagayan Valley regional coordinator Jhames Paredes; National Council of Churches in the Philippines program assistant and Taripnong Cagayan Valley secretariat member Anne Pascual; Bayan Muna Cagayan Valley coordinator Nelson Escalante; Punganay Cagayan Valley coordinator Marifel Macalanda; and Kabataan Party-list regional coordinator Walter Villegas.

Meanwhile, five others have been previously slapped with similar complaints in January 2025. They are Isabelo Adviento, a former fourth nominee of Anakpawis Party-list; Makabayan Cagayan Valley regional coordinator Agnes Mesina; Kilusang Magbubukid ng Pilipinas National Council member Cita Managuelod; Karapatan National Council member Jackie Valencia; and Pinoy Weekly journalist Deo Montesclaros.

“This new wave of attacks against us is alarming because for them, our advocacy of providing services for the farmers, campaign for more budget in education and classrooms, and proper disaster response are terrorism,” said Paredes during the protest.

Paredes is a student at University of the Philippines (UP) and a former contributor of Northern Dispatch, an alternative media outfit reporting people’s issues in Northern Luzon.

“Of course, the initial reaction was fear when we first heard it. Because the main objective of filing these cases is to sow fear, silence us, and stop us from joining organizations that defend our rights,” Paredes told Bulatlat in Filipino. “However, this fear does not last long. There are many people who were also charged with these cases which were later dismissed. This is a form of judicial harassment.”

Three activists of Cagayan Valley filed their counter-affidavits before the Office of the Provincial Prosecutor in Tuguegarao City, Cagayan, before they went to the DOJ and SC in Manila.

The case stemmed from statements made by alleged military assets Elnan Tul-ag and Rex Pagbilao, who claimed they had received supplies from the activists inside an alleged New People’s Army encampment in 2019.

Local human rights organization Umaddang Cagayan Valley Para ti Karbengan said that the only evidence against the 11 Cagayan Valley activists was an uncooked rice, allegedly found decaying inside plastic containers buried underground for seven full years.

“Our protest is not only for Cagayan Valley 11 (activists), but to all victims of political persecution and judicial harassment such as the recent attacks against the Kasibu and Dupax del Norte. This is also for all our political prisoners in the region,” Paredes said.

The activists of Cagayan Valley are targeted because of their continuous defense of the natural resources, Enjo Sarmiento of the Center for Environmental Concerns said.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Gjoa Haven residents concerned over alleged contaminated soil near homes
content:
A pile of dark, wet-looking soil and debris that appeared in Kyle Aglukkaq’s neighbourhood in Gjoa Haven for less than 24 hours this week immediately raised concerns.


“[It] reeked of diesel and clearly showed signs of debris,” Aglukkaq wrote over Facebook Messenger Wednesday. “So many kids play around here [and] the smell will travel into our homes and linger.”


It showed up Tuesday and was gone by Wednesday morning.


The property on which the mound of soil was placed belongs to Gjoa Haven-based contractor CAP Enterprises Ltd. Owner Charlie Cahill says that, to fill a swale that forms each year near the road, he brought in excess sand and gravel from another site near the property and from a parking lot the business is building in town.


He told Nunatsiaq News the diesel smell could be due to the parking lot material or due to diesel being trapped in the permafrost beneath the swale, into which his workers dug.


“I think the issue has been overblown,” he said.


Jennifer Wakegijig, Gjoa Haven’s chief administrative officer, wrote in an email that the hamlet has received complaints that allege the material could be from the remnants of a telecommunications building that was

destroyed by fire

 in 2022.


The building housed the hamlet’s main fibre connection, workstations, data centre, servers and hosting services, such as telephone and video conferencing. The Government of Nunavut also used it on a lease-to-own agreement with NCC Properties Ltd., a subsidiary of NCC Investment Group Ltd., which also owns NCC Development Ltd.


The hamlet had allowed NCC to store the rubble near the community’s power plant in the centre of town, Wakegijig said. The company was supposed to remove the material on a sealift in 2024, but it has remained in the community.


“When it was still there in the winter of 2024, the hamlet had requested with each successive sealift, every few months, that the unsightly pile of rubble be removed,” Wakegijig said.


The company did not respond to Nunatsiaq News’ requests for comment before publication. Wakegijig said NCC Development Ltd. told the hamlet that it will investigate why the materials haven’t been removed and that it plans to remove the material this week.


Although Cahill said the material he used on the CAP Enterprises property is not from the destroyed NCC building, the hamlet said it will inform the Department of Environment of the situation so it can investigate.

title: Rechenzentren (im KI-Boom) und die katastrophalen Umweltauswirkungen der Digitalisierung
content:
Dossier


„…

Die ETC Group leistet mit „Hinter den Wolken – Die Umweltauswirkungen der Digitalisierung“ einem neuen Bericht über die schwerwiegenden ökologischen und sozialen Risiken der Digitaltechnik, einen Beitrag zu dieser Debatte. Wir haben festgestellt, dass die Digitalisierung bestehende Ungleichheiten verschärft und eine immer stärkere Ausbeutung von Ressourcen aus der Erde, den Ozeanen und dem Weltraum erfordert. (…) Daten sind weder ätherisch noch harmlos. Sie sind ressourcenintensiv, bestehen aus Sand, Wasser, Kohle und schädlichen Chemikalien, die giftige Abfälle erzeugen. Für die Herstellung von Halbleiterchips, dem Baustein aller digitalen Dinge, werden beispielsweise Quarzsand, Quarz und hochreines Wasser benötigt. Die Fabriken für diese Chips werden auf großen Flächen gebaut, und es ist nachgewiesen, dass die Arbeiter dort schädlichen Chemikalien ausgesetzt sind

…“ span.

Meldung vom 4.9.2024 der ETC Group


 zum Bericht „Detrás de las nubes“ und mehr dazu, auch am Beispiel Lateinamerika:


„Techlash“: Der Widerstand gegen Rechenzentren in den USA ist so erfolgreich, dass er ohne post-kapitalistische Vision droht politisch vereinnahmt zu werden


„…

„Was muss geschehen, damit die Amerikaner Rechenzentren akzeptieren?“, fragte mich kürzlich ein Mitarbeiter der Demokratischen Partei auf dem Capitol Hill. Es war eine aufrichtige Frage, keine rhetorische. Rechenzentren sind zu einem Brennpunkt der US-Politik geworden: Die Amerikaner haben genug davon, und Aktivisten versuchen, deren Bau zu verhindern, während eine Gruppe aus Bauträgern, Finanziers, Technologieunternehmen und Energieerzeugern die Projekte vorantreibt, begierig darauf, die Früchte zu ernten. Das Versäumnis, diese Rechenzentren auszubauen, so behaupten sie, sei der Engpass, der dem gesellschaftsverändernden, durch künstliche Intelligenz ermöglichten Wohlstand im Wege stehe.


Dieser Konflikt hat die politische Debatte über KI neu ausgerichtet, die sich nun ganz darauf konzentriert, wie das Land die physische Infrastruktur aufbauen soll, von der das Schicksal der KI-Revolution abhängt. Einige basisdemokratische Widerstände gegen diese Projekte sind erfolgreich; mindestens zwanzig geplante Rechenzentrumsprojekte mit einem Investitionsvolumen von fast 42 Milliarden Dollar wurden im ersten Quartal 2026 nach heftigen öffentlichen Protesten gestrichen. Dennoch bleibt unklar, inwieweit Politiker bereit sind, KI gänzlich zu stoppen. Geschickte Mandatsträger wie die Gouverneurin von New York, Kathy Hochul, könnten durchaus Vorteile im Wahljahr darin sehen, den Ausbau der KI vorübergehend auszusetzen – einen Ausbau, der kurzfristig disruptiv ist, gerade weil er langfristig (angeblich) unvermeidlich ist. (…)


All diese Entwicklungen verdeutlichen die Stärke der Bewegung gegen Rechenzentren; ihre Organisatoren haben eine mächtige politische Kraft aufgebaut und kanalisieren neue, von der Bevölkerung getragene Energien, die Politiker mittlerweile unmöglich ignorieren können. Doch ohne eine umfassendere Vision dafür, was mit dieser Technologie geschehen soll – ohne ein weitreichenderes Ziel neben dem Slogan „Keine Rechenzentren“ –, besteht die Gefahr, dass dieser „Techlash“ im Sande verläuft, von den Wirtschaftseliten vereinnahmt und auf politische Maßnahmen gelenkt wird, die das Wachstum der KI-Infrastruktur lediglich steuern, anstatt es in Frage zu stellen oder neu auszurichten. (…)


Wir könnten den Widerstand gegen Rechenzentren als eine „Koalition in media res“ charakterisieren, die einen Echtzeit-Einblick in das bietet, was der Kulturtheoretiker Stuart Hall als „die Produktion von Politik – Politik als Produktion“ bezeichnet hat. Wir beobachten, wie neue Schauplätze politischer Auseinandersetzungen, die aus dem Zusammenwirken verschiedener Kräfte entstehen, „grundsätzlich offen“ sind und selten „bereits einheitliche kollektive politische Identitäten oder bereits konstituierte Formen des Kampfes“ widerspiegeln. Tatsächlich haben einige Demonstranten generative KI genutzt, um Plakate für Kundgebungen gegen Rechenzentren zu erstellen – ein Hinweis darauf, dass nicht jeder, der gegen KI-Infrastruktur ist, die Technologie für nutzlos hält. Kann die Opposition gegen Rechenzentren angesichts interner Widersprüche im Laufe der Zeit eine dauerhafte politische Formation bilden? author: David Swanson
title: Tens of Thousands Take Action for Nonviolent Solutions: Campaign Nonviolence Action Days 2026
content:
By Rivera Sun, World BEYOND War, September 10, 2026


Nonviolent solutions are everywhere!


Tens of thousands of people are joining the annual

Campaign Nonviolence Action Days

 from September 21 to October 2. For 13 years, Campaign Nonviolence has been rallying tens of thousands of people each year to take action to build a culture of peace and active nonviolence, free from war, poverty, racism, and environmental destruction. Spanning the 12 days from the International Day of Peace to the International Day of Nonviolence, the international campaign will highlight what nonviolence looks like on the structural or systemic level. To this end, hundreds of groups will be holding events and actions to “reflect, educate, and act to advance nonviolent solutions.”


Nonviolent solutions are programs, policies, and practices that interrupt violence, repair harm, and replace destructive systems. Just as violence can be more than physical, so can nonviolence. Systems and structures that currently cause harm through inequality, discrimination, racism, poverty, and environmental destruction should – and can – be replaced with effective alternatives anchored in justice, peace, inclusion, healing, dignity, and respect. From mass incarceration to the climate crisis, people around the world are campaigning to stop these harmful injustices and implement better systems that move humanity toward a just, peaceful future on a living planet.


What are these nonviolent solutions? They come in many shapes and sizes.


One set of solutions addresses conflicts in our lives, homes, schools, and workplaces. These practices include: restorative justice, violence prevention programs, conflict resolution in schools, dialogue, peacebuilding, reconciliation, bystander intervention, community safety, mental health support, trauma-informed policies, active listening, peer mediation, youth diversion programs, nonviolent communication, and more.


Other nonviolent solutions work toward environmental protection, such as renewable energy, reforestation, fossil fuel divestment, biodiversity protection, reuse and recycling programs, plant-based diets, marine sanctuaries, and so forth. Some of these concepts have profound ripple effects; for example, green spaces can dramatically

lower urban temperatures

 during heat waves, and also

decrease crime and depression

.


A third collection of solutions addresses underlying issues of economic injustice and inequality: living wages, universal basic income, affordable healthcare, affordable housing, reparations, free mass public transit, debt abolition, free and affordable higher education, universal childcare, and more. Some solutions require high-level policy change, like national poverty reduction programs. Others are grassroots-led, like mutual aid or lending circles.


Nonviolent solutions range from familiar, everyday things (like skills for handling disagreements with friends) to big, visionary ideas that may seem impossible at first (like war abolition). Yet, the solutions are entwined and interconnected; everyday solutions offer a glimpse of what a world beyond war and violence might look like. When a violence interruption program can halt gun violence in an urban neighborhood, we can imagine how similar programs might be able to keep civilians safer in war zones. When we understand that the use of civil resistance worldwide has replaced armed conflicts with nonviolent methods that are

twice as effective

, we can dare to envision a world in which nations invest more in civilian-based defense and nonviolent action than in military power.


Campaign Nonviolence Action Days is a time when thousands of people move into action to bring the vision of this nonviolent world closer to reality. Across 24 states and more than 17 countries, people will be holding vigils, rallies, documentary film screenings, discussions, marches, advocacy meetings, concerts, art-making events, teach-ins, trainings, and direct actions. They will also be practicing nonviolent solutions in the field, such as holding restorative circles, peace team deployments, healing circles, and using active bystander training in public spaces. Additional groups will be working on clean up actions to address plastic waste, LGBTQ+ rights and inclusion gatherings, mental health, de-escalation skills, conflict prevention, animal rights, planting trees, self-care and wellness, community gardens, healthy masculinity, domestic violence prevention …

author: Harriet Williamson
title: Zack Polanski Demands Full Release of Report Warning of Ecosystem Collapse
content:
Zack Polanski is calling on the government to publish the full, unredacted version of a report outlining how ecosystem collapse will plunge Britain into a national security crisis. 


The report from UK intelligence chiefs warns that global ecosystem degradation and collapse will have

devastating security consequences

 for Britain, including price rises, geopolitical instability, food and water shortages, greater pandemic risk, increased migration and conflict. 


The Joint Intelligence Committee’s report was published

in a redacted version in January

 and despite pressure from MPs and journalists, the Labour government has so far refused to release it in full. 


Green party leader Polanski called on prime minister Andy Burnham to “tell the truth”, arguing that the public has a right to know the full scale of the threat.


Speaking at the Wild Summit in Bristol, Polanski said: “We’ve already seen how fragile our food systems are this year, with farmers warning that we could see empty shelves as a result of drought and flooding, and the government whispering that we should start stocking up on tinned food and bottled water. 


“And these buried reports lay bare how unprepared we are for what is coming.”


The report identifies six ecosystems critical for UK national security given the likelihood and impact of their collapse, including the Amazon rainforest, Congo Basin and the boreal forests of Russia and Canada.  


It states that p

olitical polarisation, economic instability, terrorism and disinformation will increase in food and water insecure areas and as populations become more vulnerable to natural disasters. 


Polanski, expected to be the Green party’s candidate in the upcoming Holborn and St Pancras byelection, also challenged the PM to “act on the scale of the threat” by introducing a Nature, Biodiversity and National Security Act “to put resilience at the heart of government”. 


British farming hit a crisis point this year and

is projected to see its worst harvest since 1984

with key crops failing and increased livestock death due to the climate emergency. 


The UK experienced months of extreme summer temperatures alongside what the National Farmers Union called “the worst drought in 50 years”.

title: Clôture de la rencontre Arts, Résistances et Rébellions au Caracol Jacinto Canek, Chiapas
content:
Après 29 jours, et avec plus d'un millier de participants venus de presque 40 pays différents, vient de s'achever la série de présentations, d'ateliers et de performances que les camarades zapatistes ont convoqués et organisés sur leur territoire. Ils nous ont annoncé la présence de 1111 zapatistes à Mexico, 20 ans après leur dernière venue, pour se tenir aux côtés des Mères et Pères cherchant sans relâche leurs proches disparus* à travers tout le pays.


Textes et photos par : Alexis & Piankov


Traduction de l'espagnol : Claudio


Après 29 jours, et avec plus d'un millier de participants venus de presque 40 pays différents, vient de s'achever la série de présentations, d'ateliers et de performances que les camarades zapatistes ont convoqués et organisés sur leur territoire. Ils nous ont annoncé la présence de 1111 zapatistes à Mexico, 20 ans après leur dernière venue, pour se tenir aux côtés des Mères et Pères cherchant sans relâche leurs proches disparus* à travers tout le pays.


Durant toute la rencontre, et jusqu'à sa clôture, ont eu lieu des performances musicales, de la poésie et de la prose, tant de la part des zapatistes eux-mêmes que des participants extérieurs. Les ateliers furent variés : impressions de sérigraphie sur t-shirt ou papier, auto-défense féminine, marches en territoire zapatiste pour explorer la biodiversité et les paysages volcaniques caractéristiques des montagnes du sud-est mexicain, entre autres.


Sur la scène centrale s'est tenue la représentation d'un groupe de jeunes zapatistes autour de la pièce «

 

Le commun et le jour d'après

 

», qui renoue avec les principes d'une vie harmonieuse entre les membres d'une communauté et la nature, à travers l'organisation. Avec une emphase sur l'abolition des violences patriarcales, de la propriété privée et des vieux travers de l'ancienne société. Se sont cultivés le partage, la solidarité et l'empathie en faveur d'une vie commune pour éliminer le système capitaliste.


Cette œuvre nous invite à réfléchir sur les jours à venir, sur la force et l'organisation que nous devons avoir pour ne pas permettre au capitalisme de ressurgir. Car nous savons que, comme une maladie, il sera latent pendant plusieurs années, à nous guetter

 

; et que sûrement les survivants qui n'auront pas commencé tout de suite à s'organiser autrement reproduiront les mêmes logiques qu'auparavant, simplement car il n'auront pas su faire autrement. Mais il nous faut etre plus fort et astucieux. D'où l'importance de réaliser de telles rencontres, qui nous permettent de continuer à nous confronter à d'autres réalités, d'échanger des connaissances et de maintenir vivant l'espoir.


En plus de la pièce et de la force d'organisation que nous ont démontrés nos camarades zapatistes lors de cette rencontre, ils nous ont laissé dans le cœur leur grande générosité et un exemple pour faire les choses différemment. Les soirées à danser, les journées radieuses avec les enfants jouant et illuminant tout sur leur passage. Des mères, des pères, et toute une communauté prenant soin collectivement les uns des autres. Femmes et hommes jouant au basket, aux échecs, échangeant des blagues avec les étrangers. Cette rencontre nous aura laissé la montagne et la pleine lune dans les bras, la nourriture, la nature, et au loin le Winikton (l'homme de pierre) observant nos pas.


Sans aucun doute, tout ceci a constitué un espace de formation à travers la culture. Des anciens combattants chantant sur la prise de San Cristobal jusqu'au jeunes poètes chantant à la liberté, les expressions artistiques ont appuyé le fait que les luttes en commun pour les communs sont des outils pour sauver ce qui nous reste d'humanité et arriver au jour d'après.


Finalement, lors de la clôture de l'évènement, le sous-commandant Moisés a insisté sur la nécessité de nous organiser chacun sur son territoire, de faire du «

 

buen vivir

 

» (du «

 

bon vivre **

 

») un art - que le système capitaliste nous a dénié -, de l'importance de partager les savoirs, de la convergence de nos actions, et surtout de la persévérance dans cette lutte qui avance lentement mais sûrement.


*Les personnes disparues au Mexique constituent un phénomène massif, en lien avec la violence du crime organisé.


https://basta.media/a-l-ombre-des-stades-de-foot-Mondial-2026-a-la-recherche-des-130-000-disparus-du-mexique


** Le «

 

Buen Vivir

 

», ou «

 

Lekil Kaltik

 

» en maya Tseltal, est la pratique quotidienne de l'autonomie …

title: Caminata de Warmis: “Pachamama pide a gritos que la defendamos”
content:
Durante más de un mes mujeres de la Cuenca de Pozuelos, en la Puna jujeña, recorrieron el país hasta llegar al Congreso de la Nación reclamando un freno al extractivismo contaminante que está destruyendo el agua y la tierra de sus comunidades. En Buenos Aires, la Policía de la Ciudad las hostigó y ningún legislador quiso recibirlas. Dialogamos con Florencia Solís, una de las impulsoras de la Caminata, para compartir un balance sobre esta travesía de denuncia y visibilización.

La movilización conocida como Caminata de Warmis – Mujeres del Kollasuyu en defensa de la Pachamama (en Instagram:

@caminata.warmis

), partió el 3 de agosto desde Rinconada, Jujuy, a 3.500 metros sobre el nivel del mar, y atravesó localidades de todo el país, del norte hacia la Capital, donde mantuvieron encuentros con comunidades y el activismo ambiental.


Decidieron la fecha porque agosto es, entre otras cosas, el mes de la Pachamama.


En la Ciudad de Buenos Aires realizaron diversas actividades, entre las cuales la central fue la movilización hasta el Congreso de la Nación. En ese trayecto fueron hostigadas por efectivos policiales, tanto en la caminata por Avenida Rivadavia partiendo desde Once -donde quedaron impactadas tras ver “mucha gente abandonada, mucha pobreza”, dijo Florencia, conmovida porque en su comunidad “en mi lugar mío, no hay eso”- como en los alrededores del Congreso.


Allí ningún legislador las recibió, pero por la insistencia, al menos les recibieron los petitorios.


Finalmente, y tras más de un mes de recorrer el país, las Warmis volvieron a Jujuy. Desde allí, telefónicamente, hablamos con Florencia Solís, para hacer un balance de todo lo vivido.

title: FAU apoya el hospital impulsado por el zapatismo en México
content:
En su congreso nacional celebrado en mayo de 2026, la FAU decidió apoyar al movimiento zapatista en México con 10 000 € procedentes de las cuotas de sus miembres para la construcción de un hospital. La región cuenta con muy poca infraestructura de salud, por lo que les zapatistas, junto con muchas otras personas, están construyendo un hospital autoorganizado para todes.


Desde 1994, el movimiento zapatista de Chiapas, México, organizan una vida autónoma basada en valores anticapitalistas y humanistas, lo que les convierte en un ejemplo para movimientos de todo el mundo. Nos sentimos estrechamente vinculades al movimiento zapatista en su lucha y sus ideales. Juntes luchamos por los medios de vida de la humanidad y por sociedades justas.


El artículo original se puede leer aquí: 

https://www.fau.org/artikel/es_fau-spendet-fuer-zapatistas-in-mexiko


A continuación, reproducimos nuestra carta a les zapatistas:


Saludos desde la FAU en Alemania


Querides hermanes zapatistas,


Os habla la Federación Anarcosindicalista (FAU) de Alemania. No sabemos si aún se acuerdan de nosotres, entre tantos contactos que tienen. El año pasado tuvimos el honor de ser invitades al Encuentro «Algunas Partes del Todo» y, además, nuestros caminos ya se han cruzado en otras ocasiones.


En nuestro congreso anual decidimos aportar 10 000 € a su hospital y esperamos que eso les facilite un poco la vida cotidiana. Este dinero no proviene del Estado, ni lo ganamos en la lotería; proviene de las cuotas de nuestres miembres, que todes les trabajadores aportan cada mes de su salario para impulsar la lucha por un mundo más justo.


Sin embargo, este dinero es solo una manifestación de algo más profundo: Vemos su movimiento, lo hemos visto desde hace muchos años. Nos inspira en nuestro propio movimiento. Nos inspira a desaprender cosas que nos enseñaron aquí, en el corazón de la bestia. Y nos inspira – en un país que no se destaca precisamente por su sentido del humor – a reír más en nuestras serias tareas diarias, a alegrarnos con la risa de les niñes** o a enviar una sonrisa tras una mariposa**. ¡Gracias por este regalo, que a muches de nosotres nos mantiene en marcha al menos tan bien como su delicioso café!


Sabemos que en casa siempre tienen más que suficiente que hacer, por eso no queremos ocupar más su tiempo con esta carta. Solo queremos señalar que, a nivel internacional, estamos organizades junto con organizaciones similares en la Confederación Internacional del Trabajo (ICL), cuyas organizaciones, en su mayoría, sienten un afecto similar por ustedes.


Estamos organizades con la ICL en los siguientes países: Reino Unido (IWW), Francia (CNT), Alemania (FAU), Polonia (OZZ IP), Grecia (ESE), Italia (USI), España (CNT), Canadá y los Estados Unidos (IWW), Argentina (FORA), Brasil (FOB), Myanmar (FGWM) y Australia (IWW). También contamos con buenes amigues en algunos otros países.


Compartimos su preocupación por el futuro; nosotres también vemos que se avecina una gran tormenta, tal vez el mayor desafío de la humanidad. Hasta ahora nos hemos organizado principalmente con otros sindicatos, pero muches de nosotres creemos que debemos ampliar nuestra perspectiva y tender la mano. Nos fijamos más en los movimientos de communidades indígenas, nos fijamos en alianzas como el Foro Nyeleni. **Pero es así, como ustedes dicen: El **trabajo principal siempre está a la puerta de casa.


Si tienen alguna pregunta para nosotres, o si nuestros contactos internacionales les pueden ser de utilidad, no duden en contactarnos. Si quieren compartir sus contactos internacionales con nosotres, también serán bienvenidos. Como ICL, nos reunimos mensualmente en línea para intercambiar ideas, en inglés o en español. Si alguna vez quieren participar como invitades para informarnos, hacer preguntas o compartir sus opiniones, no duden en avisarnos.

Manténganse alegres, manténganse valientes, manténganse sanes,


sus compañeres de la FAU


La entrada

FAU apoya el hospital impulsado por el zapatismo en México

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

title: Nurses Across US Demand Hospitals Cut Ties With Palantir, Citing ICE and Gaza
content:
National Nurses United is expanding its campaign against Palantir in a global week of action starting on September 28.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

National Nurses United (NNU), the largest union of registered nurses in the U.S., is demanding that hospitals cut ties with Palantir, with nurses citing the firm’s role in developing technology used to surveil immigrants in the U.S. and target civilians in Gaza.

The union – which represents more than 225,000 nurses in all 50 U.S. states — has announced a global week of action against Palantir, set to begin on September 28.

Palantir’s “AI-powered tools for large-scale data collection and mass surveillance… threaten human rights globally,” the union said in a press release announcing the campaign.

The global week of action is aimed at pushing all public institutions — including hospitals and other health care providers — to end contracts and partnerships with Palantir, and to divest from the company, the union said.

The global week of action builds on a national day of action, also led by the union, which saw demonstrations in eight cities across the U.S. on August 27, including in Portland, Maine; Washington, D.C.; Chicago; Austin; and Los Angeles.

The global week of action is also coordinated with health care workers in the U.K., where National Health Service (NHS) workers and activists will protest Palantir’s use in health care on October 1. Other organizations, like Amnesty International and the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) Movement, are also part of the global week of action.

“Palantir has no place in patient care, no place in our communities, and no place in our society,” a NNU nurse said in a video from the August 27 day of action.

The nurses have outlined Palantir’s complicity in human rights violations both nationally and internationally, from detentions of immigrants by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to the genocide in Gaza.

“We think that a company that specializes in mass surveillance, kidnappings and killings, has no place in patient care,” one nurse explained in a video posted by the California Nurses Association.

During the August day of action, nurses placed 50 pairs of baby shoes in the street in each city – to represent the 500 babies and toddlers who have been detained in immigrant jails since President Donald Trump started his second term. The nurses also brought letters written by children in ICE detention.

“Palantir, we know, helps ICE identify people to kidnap off of our streets,” another nurse said during the day of action.

The company also has “their hands in the genocide and murders of civilians in Gaza,” another nurse present at the protests said. “They’ve [helped with the targeting of] hospitals, schools, mission workers taking food and aid….”

In a statement shared with Truthout and read at the August 27 day of action, Chicago-based nurse and NNU member Elizabeth Lalasz said that “nurses, health care workers, our patients, immigrants, and allies from every walk of life stand united here in Chicago and all across the country to demand an immediate end to the violence inflicted by Palantir technologies and the Trump administration.”

“As we speak, Palantir’s AI is enabling atrocities and human rights abuses: ICE killings, mass deportation, and concentration camps with no access to health care – even the imprisonment of more than 500 babies and 6,200 children – and Palantir is providing the technology for Israel’s U.S.-funded genocide in Gaza, the cruel and illegal war in Iran, and mass surveillance at home and abroad,” she went on.

Lalasz also noted that Palantir has partnered with the world’s largest health care corporations “to suck more and more profit from our broken health care system, causing untold suffering in our hospitals.”

“This country could fund health care for 12 million children with the money spent on ICE detention alone,” she said.

João Paulo Connolly, an activist in the Bay Area who has organized protests against Palantir, explained in a webinar that “Palantir’s profit model is data extraction and surveillance,” and then “giving employers new, powerful ways to monitor and spy on their workers at all times and track their behavior,” while also selling the health care industry and the federal government “unprecedented levels of access” to this data.

title: İstanbul Barosu’ndan engelli çocukların eğitim hakkı için veli rehberi
content:
İstanbul Barosu Engelli Hakları Merkezi, yeni eğitim-öğretim döneminde engelli çocukların ve ailelerinin okullarda karşılaşabileceği hak ihlallerine karşı 

“Eğitimde Sağlamcılığa Hayır! Engelli Çocukların Eğitim Hakkı İçin Veli Rehberi”

 başlıklı bir çalışma yayımladı.


Eylül 2026 tarihli 68 sayfalık rehber; okul kaydı, sağlık raporu talepleri, “gölge öğretmen” dayatması, başka okula ya da sınıfa yönlendirme, Bireyselleştirilmiş Eğitim Programı (BEP), destek eğitim odası, erişilebilirlik, yardımcı cihazlar, akran zorbalığı, ayrımcılık ve mahremiyet gibi başlıkları ele alıyor. Ailelerin sorun yaşaması halinde başvurabileceği idari ve hukuki yollar ile örnek dilekçeler de rehberde yer alıyor.


“Çözüm çocuğu eğitim ortamından uzaklaştırmak değil”


Rehberde öne çıkan sorunlardan biri, engelli çocukların okul kaydı sırasında karşılaştığı doğrudan ya da dolaylı ret uygulamaları.


Baro, bir çocuğun engelli olmasının tek başına okul kaydının reddedilmesi için gerekçe oluşturamayacağını hatırlatıyor. Okulların “Bu okul çocuğunuza uygun değil”, “Sınıf çok kalabalık”, “Öğretmenimiz bu konuda eğitimli değil” ya da “Başka okul daha iyi olur” gibi gerekçelerle çocuğu eğitim ortamından uzaklaştırmasının eğitim hakkını ortadan kaldırmadığını belirtiyor.


Engelli Odaklı Habercilik Atölyesi sona erdi: "Kafamızdaki sağlamcıyı öldürmeliyiz"


25 Haziran 2026


“Gölge öğretmen tutamazsanız okula alamayız” denilemez


Rehberin dikkat çektiği uygulamalardan biri de bazı ailelerden çocuklarının okula devam edebilmesi için kendi imkanlarıyla “gölge öğretmen” ya da destek personeli sağlamalarının istenmesi.


İstanbul Barosu, çocuğun sınıf içinde desteğe ihtiyaç duyması halinde öncelikle BEP, destek eğitim ve sınıf içi uyarlamalar gibi kamusal yükümlülüklerin değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini vurguluyor.


Ailenin ekonomik gücüyle özel bir personel çalıştırabilmesi ile çocuğun anayasal eğitim hakkının birbirine karıştırılamayacağını belirten rehber, okul kabulünün ailenin ücretini ödeyeceği bir personel bulmasına bağlanmasının eğitim hakkı ve ayrımcılık yasağı bakımından ciddi hukuki sorun doğurabileceğine dikkat çekiyor.


Okul yönetimi tek başına “Bu çocuk bu sınıfta yapamaz” diyemez


Baro ayrıca, engelli bir öğrencinin başka okula veya özel eğitim sınıfına gönderilmesine yalnızca öğretmenin ya da okul yönetiminin karar veremeyeceğini hatırlatıyor.


Çocuğun eğitim ortamının değiştirilmesinin eğitsel değerlendirme ve tanılama sürecine bağlı olduğu; değerlendirmelerin Rehberlik ve Araştırma Merkezi (RAM) bünyesindeki kurul tarafından yapılması gerektiği belirtiliyor.


Yerleştirme kararında velinin yazılı talebinin de dikkate alınması gerekiyor. Bu nedenle öğretmenin ya da okul müdürünün “Bu çocuk burada yapamaz” şeklindeki değerlendirmesinin tek başına yerleştirme kararı sayılamayacağı ifade ediliyor.


Engelsiz Erişim Derneği: Otizm “farkındalık” değil, kabul ve eşit erişim meselesi


2 Nisan 2026


Destek eğitim odası çocuğu sınıftan uzaklaştırmanın aracı değil


Rehber, tam zamanlı kaynaştırma/bütünleştirme yoluyla eğitim gören öğrenciler bakımından destek eğitim odalarına da geniş yer ayırıyor.


Destek eğitim odasında verilecek eğitimin öğrencinin haftalık toplam ders saatinin yüzde 40'ını aşamayacağı; temel olarak bire bir yürütüleceği, BEP geliştirme biriminin kararıyla en fazla üç öğrenciden oluşan gruplarla da eğitim yapılabileceği aktarılıyor.


Ancak rehber özellikle bir noktaya dikkat çekiyor: Destek eğitim odası, öğrenciyi akranlarından soyutlamak veya genel eğitim sınıfından uzaklaştırmak için kullanılamaz.


Okul yönetiminin “odamız yok” ya da “öğretmenimiz yok” demesinin de tek başına öğrencinin ihtiyaç duyduğu desteğin karşılanmamasını hukuken haklı hale getirmeyeceği belirtiliyor.


Zorbalığa karşı önlem almak okulun yükümlülüğü


Çalışmanın “Güvenli okul, ayrımcılık ve mahremiyet” bölümünde engelli çocukların karşılaşabileceği akran zorbalığı da ele alınıyor.


Alay etme, hakaret, tehdit, dışlama, fiziksel şiddet, çocuğun eşyalarına veya kullandığı yardımcı cihazlara müdahale ve dijital ortamda rahatsız etme zorbalığın farklı biçimleri arasında sayılıyor.


Rehber, Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı'nın ilgili genelgelerine işaret ederek okul yönetimlerinin zorbalığa yol açabilecek riskleri belirlemek, önleyici tedbir almak ve rehberlik hizmetlerini işletmekle yükümlü olduğunu hatırlatıyor.


Ailelere her bir olayı tarih, yer ve gerçekleşme biçimiyle ayrı ayrı kaydetmeleri öneriliyor.


Çürük


7 Eylül 2026


Yardımcı cihazı …

title: Zayıflama iğneleri tehlikeli mi? Bilim ne diyor, sağlıkçılar ne öneriyor?
content:
Kilo kaybı sağlayan ilaçlar, obezite tedavisinde önemli bir seçenek haline geldi. Ancak “zayıflama iğnesi” olarak bilinen bu ilaçlar masum birer kilo verme ürünü değil. Bilimsel çalışmalar etkili olduklarını gösterirken, ciddi yan etkiler ve yanlış kullanım riskleri de bulunuyor. İlaçların hekim değerlendirmesi ve yaşam tarzı değişiklikleriyle birlikte kullanılmasının ise önemi büyük.

Son yıllarda sosyal medyanın da etkisiyle kilo vermek isteyenlerin gündemine giren GLP-1 temelli ilaçlar, aslında başlangıçta özellikle tip 2 diyabetin tedavisinde kullanılan ilaçlar arasında yer alıyordu. Semaglutid ve tirzepatid gibi etken maddeler iştahı azaltıyor, tokluk hissini artırıyor ve kan şekeri düzenlenmesine yardımcı oluyor. Bu etkiler, obezite tedavisinde de kullanılmalarının önünü açtı.

Ancak bu ilaçları “hızlı kilo verme iğnesi” olarak görmek önemli bir yanılgı. Dünya Sağlık Örgütü (DSÖ), 2025'te yayımladığı kılavuzda semaglutid, tirzepatid ve liraglutid gibi GLP-1 ilaçlarının yetişkinlerde obezitenin uzun süreli tedavisinde kullanılabileceğini koşullu olarak önerdi. DSÖ, bunun yanında uzun dönem güvenlilik, tedavinin bırakılması sonrası ne olacağı, maliyet ve sağlık sistemlerinin bu tedavilere hazırlığı konusunda belirsizlikler bulunduğuna dikkat çekti.

Evet. Bu ilaçların kilo kaybı konusunda güçlü bilimsel kanıtları bulunuyor. Özellikle semaglutid ve tirzepatid, iştah ve enerji alımı üzerinde etkili olarak kişilerin daha az yemek yemesine yardımcı olabiliyor. Ancak alınan sonuç kişiden kişiye değişiyor ve ilaçların etkisi, tedavinin süresi ve kişinin yaşam tarzıyla yakından ilişkili.

Bu nedenle sağlık otoriteleri ilaçları diyet ve fiziksel aktivitenin alternatifi olarak değil, obezitenin kapsamlı tedavisinin bir parçası olarak değerlendiriyor. DSÖ de GLP-1 ilaçları kullanan obezitesi olan yetişkinlere yapılandırılmış sağlıklı beslenme ve fiziksel aktivite programlarının eşlik etmesini öneriyor.

Doğru hastada, uygun dozda ve hekim gözetiminde kullanıldığında bu ilaçların yararları ve riskleri klinik olarak değerlendirilmiş durumda. Ancak ciddi yan etki potansiyelleri nedeniyle gelişigüzel kullanılmaları güvenli değil.

En sık karşılaşılan sorunlar arasında bulantı, kusma, ishal, kabızlık, karın ağrısı, hazımsızlık gibi şikâyetler bulunuyor.

Bunların yanı sıra ilaçların resmi güvenlik bilgilerinde pankreatit, safra kesesi hastalıkları, böbrek hasarı ve ciddi gastrointestinal reaksiyonlar gibi daha önemli riskler de yer alıyor. Bazı hastalarda kan şekeri düşüklüğü ve diyabetik retinopati komplikasyonları da önem taşıyor.

Bu nedenle “yan etkisi sadece biraz mide bulantısı” şeklindeki yaklaşım doğru değil.

İlaçların etkili olabilmesi kadar doğru dozda kullanılması da önemli. Özellikle doktor kontrolü dışında kullanılan ürünlerde doz hataları ciddi problemlere yol açabiliyor. ABD Gıda ve İlaç Dairesi (FDA), onaysız veya bileşik olarak hazırlanan semaglutid ürünlerinde yanlış doz kullanımına bağlı olarak hastaneye yatış gerektiren vakalar bildirildiğini açıkladı.

Bildirilen sorunlar arasında şiddetli bulantı ve kusma, karın ağrısı, susuz kalma, pankreatit ve safra taşı bulunuyor.

Uzmanların en önemli uyarılarından biri de ilacın nereden temin edildiği. FDA, onaylanmamış semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünlerinin güvenlilik, etkinlik ve kalite açısından piyasaya çıkmadan önce kurumun değerlendirmesinden geçmediğini belirtiyor.

Daha da önemlisi, kurum sahte semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünleri tespit edildiğini; bazı ürünlerin etiketlerinde gerçekte bulunmayan eczanelerin isimlerinin dahi kullanılabildiğini bildiriyor.

Bu nedenle sosyal medya üzerinden, internet sitelerinden veya doktor değerlendirmesi olmadan satılan ürünler ile ruhsatlı ilaçların aynı şey olmadığı unutulmamalı.

Bu ilaçların temel kullanım alanı obezite veya belirli koşullarla aşırı kiloluluk gibi tıbbi durumların tedavisi. Sırf birkaç kilo vermek isteyen sağlıklı bir kişinin sosyal medyada gördüğü bir ilaçla kendi kendine tedaviye başlaması doğru değil. Tedavi kararı verilirken kişinin kilosunun yanı sıra boyu, vücut kitle indeksi, eşlik eden hastalıkları, kullandığı ilaçlar, beslenme alışkanlıkları ve diğer sağlık koşulları birlikte değerlendirilmeli.

Ayrıca gebelik söz konusu olduğunda GLP-1 tedavileri kullanılmamalı; DSÖ'nün obezite kılavuzu da hamile kadınları kapsam dışında bırakıyor.

Burada da önemli bir ayrıntı var. GLP-1 ilaçlarının iştah üzerindeki etkisi tedavi sürdüğü sürece devam eder. Tedavi bırakıldığında iştahın yeniden artması ve …

An Unfortunate Dead End — On Universal Healthcare

The Path Forward — Creation and Disruption

Interlocking Fronts — A call to Solidarity with Other Movements

Lights, Camera, Action – Immediate Steps

To answer the question of why the December 4th execution of UHC CEO Brian Thompson happened seems easy. Denials, price gouging, and the health insurance industry at large. However, as one unravels the outpouring of stories and symbolism in its wake, one finds it difficult to wrestle into a specific activist program. The questions one runs into are so urgent, but so foundational, that they resist easy answers.

Who lives and who dies? Who is healed and who is hurt? Who takes resources and who loses them?

There are no quick fixes to this system’s problems. Even if you personally have good insurance coverage and good health, you have seen loved ones struggle to afford or access lifesaving care. You have seen the downstream effects of for-profit healthcare in rising costs, closed hospitals, under-staffing, wait times, bureaucratic obfuscation. You have seen people lose everything to cover cancer care, forced to choose between rescue inhalers and rent, while c-suites get rich off the blood in the streets. It is impossible to avoid the growing realization that there are no quick fixes to this system’s problems because this system is the problem.

This is a part of the reason the events of December 4th resonated across the globe. While the “united states” is particularly bad in this regard, paying substantially more for worse care, other countries still struggle. “britain” has such lengthy wait lists for gender affirming care that the system forces trans people out of the country. “canada” may have universal healthcare that makes public hospitals and clinics available, but even still, has increasingly privatized some care, leading to 17.5% of the population to significant medical debt,[1] and the healthcare regime also pushes disabled people toward assisted suicide programs.[2] In Cuba, healthcare is free but US sanctions manufacture health scarcity by blocking the flow of technologies and medications both to punish Cuba for fighting western imperial capitalism and as propaganda against free healthcare.[3]

Within the “united states”, attempts to revise policies for better health outcomes have met little success.4 This is because such attempts do not fundamentally change the power dynamic at play, so insurance companies and hospital corporations continue raising prices, deciding what care gets covered, and limiting available services regardless of what laws are passed or revoked. Reform is not the solution when the system kills for profit.

We do not want to simply renegotiate the terms of a hostage scenario. We want the power to no longer be hostages.
