author: Randi Beers
title: News quiz Sept. 12 | Stranger than fiction
content:
It’s quiz time! Let’s roll.


1. An Ottawa-based non-profit is paying Nunavut teens to do what while scrolling their social media feeds?


A. Report the types of advertisements they are seeing.


B. Fact check viral social media posts.


C. Like and share posts about from the organization about media literacy.


2. Nunatsiaq News introduced readers to a new northern correspondent last week. What is different about her?


A. She is a licensed pilot.


B. She is a high school student.


C. She’s not human. She’s one of 121 AI “correspondents” that repackages existing news stories for a website based out of Hong Kong.


3. Oil spills are bad for the environment, but scientists are in Chesterfield Inlet studying one type of creature seems to benefit from it. What creature is that?


A. Sea cucumbers seem to love oil and grow to massive sizes when exposed to it.


B. There are naturally occurring microbes that feed off of oil.


C. Oil adheres to plankton floating in the water, making them shimmer, which makes them more visible to predators, like whales.


4. A new development in Grise Fiord is making it easier for people to determine when it’s safe to travel. What is it?


A. Better radar and satellite imagery helps determine when precipitation is coming.


B. A new weather station about five kilometres east of the community shows real-time conditions.


C. A high school student has taken up amateur meteorology as a hobby and is providing local weather reports that residents say have been extremely accurate so far.


5. A sea can full of non-perishable food arrived this month in Igloolik, from a New Brunswick-based non-profit. How much does it cost to ship a sea can on the sealift?


A. $10,000


B. $12,000


C. $14,000


David Didier, left, a geography professor and director of the Northern and Arctic Coastal Research Lab, with his child strapped to his back, and Terry Noah, owner of Ausuittuq Adventures, install a live timelapse station near Grise Fiord on July 8. The automated camera system set up near the coastline helps researchers monitor the sea ice conditions. (Photo by Anne-Marie Dubé)


Answers:


1. B — Teens aged 13 to 19

can apply

 to learn different fact-checking skills like reverse image search and fact verification and use those skills to fact check viral posts that pop up on their social media accounts. They earn $150 for their first analysis, then $100 for subsequent fact checks.


2. C — Leah Qammaniq is an AI “correspondent” who

republishes

 copyrighted news content and renders AI images to go along with it.


3. B — Scientists are in Chesterfield Inlet

studying microbes

 that feed off of oil. Some new species have been discovered during the study, said one researcher, and local Inuit are being invited to help name these new species.


4. B — A new

weather station

 outside the community allows people to check real-time conditions before heading out onto the land. It’s part of a larger project studying coastal erosion and water conditions around Grise Fiord.


5. B — The sea can, which is filled with approximately $50,000 worth of food,

costs $12,000 to ship

, said Rick Maher, who runs the non-profit group A Tapestry of Kindness with his wife Linda Maher. The group gets some funding help from Nutrition North Canada for the project, which aims to send two sea cans per year to northern communities.

author: Unknown
title: Fire at Kobane Prison: 9 killed, 16 injured
content:
A fire broke out at a prison in Kobane. According to initial reports, 9 detainees lost their lives and 16 others were injured, some of them seriously.


 


The injured were taken to hospitals in Kobane for treatment.


 


The cause of the fire is not yet known, and the relevant authorities are continuing their investigation. Kobane’s Internal Security Forces are expected to issue a statement regarding the incident.


 


The fire at the Kobane prison broke out following public protests in the city. Protesters were demanding an investigation into the abduction and killing of Defense Ministry member Sami Hiso in Heseke.


 


General Security Forces intervened against the protesters and detained several young people from the city.


 


According to sources in the region, General Security Forces have begun surrounding the city.

author: Corey Larocque
title: ‘News’ site forces journalists to face future with AI
content:
The future arrived without warning two weeks ago, dragging Nunatsiaq News into the world of artificial intelligence controversy this paper had previously managed to avoid.


A journalist colleague at another organization sent an email, pointing out a new website that posts AI-generated articles about the North, based on news that real organizations had already reported.


We News appears to be a Hong Kong-based website using more than 100 AI-generated “correspondents” whose articles are cobbled together using artificial intelligence instead of traditional reporting. They gather their information from news articles written by real journalists and from official sources such as the RCMP and Government of Nunavut.


It calls its Nunavut correspondent Leah Qammaniq. She comes complete with an Inuit-sounding name, an AI-generated picture of a woman with Inuit features and even an AI-generated back story about being “raised in the North.”


Miriam Lafontaine, a new but very real Nunatsiaq News reporter, wrote a thorough

news story

 about this troubling development. She did it the old-fashioned way by interviewing real people, researching the issue and sitting down in front of a computer to type it out.


Our Inuit readers will decide for themselves whether We News is deceptively fabricating an imaginary Inuk reporter. But to this qalluanaaq journalist, it’s offensive to make up an Inuk correspondent out of thin air to dupe readers.


It’s bad enough that real non-Inuit pretend to be Inuit to get benefits intended for Inuit. But an AI-generated correspondent pretending to be Inuk because it’s somehow more authentic to get AI-generated news from an AI-generated correspondent?


As a journalist, this is an alarming, disappointing — but predictable — development in the intersection of news and artificial intelligence.


For the record, Nunatsiaq News does not use generative AI in its reporting or in its advertising. This is a stand news organizations are increasingly taking.


Experts in the news business were quick and unequivocal in condemning this AI intrusion into the news business.


News Media Canada president Paul Deegan called it “theft” on “an industrial scale.”


Canadian Association of Journalists president Brent Jolly said the manipulation of the public’s right to know by AI “disgusts” him. He warned that the public doesn’t realize what’s happening and more questions aren’t being asked about how to address it.


It’s not just Nunatsiaq News getting ripped off. Our hard-working colleagues — competitors at Nunavut News and CBC — are having their articles harvested by We News. Legitimate journalists must now contend with an AI-fuelled site that uses their own work to compete with them. We News appears to be displaying Google ads, so it’s making money off the backs of real journalists and their employers.


That’s why Nunatsiaq News urges its readers to be aware of where their information comes from and to avoid AI-generated information that steals the work of real journalists. We want readers to get their information from us, but if not, they should at least get it from a real news organization.


The news business is a difficult one. Having to compete for readers and advertisers against an elusive organization that uses AI to repackage our own content is going to make that even harder for real journalism to thrive.


Journalism is about storytelling — a real reporter talking to real people about what happens in their community, building trust with sources, and then sharing the story with readers.


What We News is doing is not journalism, despite the fact that it has created itself in the image of real, trusted news organizations.

author: 张皓翔
title: The General‑Strike in Human Production: Geschlechtsliebe, Marriage‑Family and the Unbinding of Labour‑Power【人的生产总罢工——Geschlechtsliebe、婚姻家庭与劳动力解绑】
content:
Rooted in the Marxist‑historical‑materialist tradition, this monograph re‑examines intimate relations, marriage, family and contemporary low‑fertility crises by drawing on Engels’ theory of two kinds of production — namely the production of material means of subsistence and the production of human‑beings themselves. It introduces the German‑language analytical category Geschlechtsliebe, which integrates bodily‑sexual dimensions (sex‑drive, sexual relations) and inter‑subjective spiritual‑affective love, to break down the common conceptual confusion among desire, romance, marital contract and demographic reproduction.

The book develops a core dialectical contradiction specific to human production: the objective reality of human production versus subjective inclinations toward human production. Against this framework, modern‑era late‑marriage, low‑fertility and child‑free choices are interpreted not merely as cultural or individual‑value shifts, but as a spontaneous general strike within the sphere of human production. Such popular refusals of procreation undermine capitalism’s access to fresh labour‑power supplies, yet remain disorganised and lack conscious socialist‑political guidance, carrying risks of self‑destruction for the working class itself.

Critically distancing itself from Social Reproduction Theory (SRT) and its “reproduction of labour‑power” paradigm, the text argues that household‑care and child‑rearing create new labour‑power, rather than repairing pre‑existing labour‑power stocks. It undertakes comparative criticism of socialist and capitalist family‑law systems, pointing out that capitalist family institutions centre on private‑property inheritance, while socialist family institutions ought to pursue de‑unilateralisation of social‑input costs in human production, mitigating the disproportionate burdens borne by women in procreation and care‑giving.

Going beyond a sole critique of private ownership, the work advances a deeper thesis: labour‑power element‑formation constitutes a more fundamental source of alienation. Even after private ownership is abolished, so long as human capacities are treated as separable, measurable, allocable elements, women will still bear one‑sided burdens within human‑production processes. Looking toward communist society, the author envisages the socialisation of human‑production workflows. Once procreation and upbringing become socialised processes, sexual relations will shed all social‑functional mandates and turn into genuinely private interpersonal affairs, and love will escape institutional regulation entirely.

This work combines political‑economy critique, comparative legal history and theoretical speculation on communist‑era gender relations. It calls for the transformation from spontaneous reproductive refusal toward the conscious socialist reconstruction of human‑production, contributing fresh arguments for Marxist theories of gender, family and emancipation.

author: 张皓翔
title: On the Illegitimacy of Fairness, Democracy, and Justice【论公平、正义、民主的非法性】
content:
This monograph undertakes a systematic theoretical demystification of the three value categories enshrined in modern society—fairness, democracy, and justice—grounded in the methodology of historical materialism. Departing from Marx and Engels’s thesis that “the ideas of the ruling class are in every epoch the ruling ideas,” the author reveals that these concepts are not transhistorical, universal values, but rather an “inverse narrative” deliberately fabricated by the ruling class in class societies to conceal the structural oppression and exploitation that they are inherently incapable of resolving. The central argument of the book is that the substantive function of fairness, democracy, and justice lies in substituting recognition for abolition and piecemeal reform for radical eradication, thereby obscuring the fundamental goal that the subjugated classes should truly pursue—liberation.

The book is organised into four chapters. Chapter One systematically establishes the theoretical basis for treating fairness, democracy, and justice as an “illegitimate narrative,” arguing that they are essentially a illusory mirror-image generated by the incurable maladies of class society. Chapter Two redefines the nature of liberation from a dialectical perspective, demonstrating that liberation is not a negative narrative but rather the most momentous affirmative construction in human history. Chapter Three carries out a “double sublation” of both bourgeois democracy and proletarian democracy, contending that democracy in any form is merely a transitional instrument rather than an ultimate end. Chapter Four establishes “liberation” as the sole criterion and red line for the institutional design of socialism and communism, and elaborates how “consciousness as labour-power” can ultimately supersede the category of democracy in practice.

The book makes several original theoretical contributions. First, through the critical method of political economy, it divests fairness, justice, and democracy of their juridical guise as eternal truths, restoring them to their actual status as ideological projections of specific relations of production. Second, it proposes the analytical framework of the “inversion of affirmative and negative narratives,” revealing how the ruling class packages false fairness and justice as “affirmative constructs” while stigmatising genuine liberation as “negative destruction.” Third, it offers a novel conceptualisation of democracy as a “means rather than a stage of existence,” thereby deepening the classical Marxist tradition of the self-sublation of proletarian democracy. This work is recommended for scholars and postgraduate students in political philosophy, Marxist theory, and scientific socialism.

author: Unknown
title: Van’da görüntüleri sonrası soruşturma açılan düğünde takılan altınlar odunluktan
content:
Van'da düğün görüntüleri sonrası 'Suçtan kaynaklanan malvarlığı değerlerini aklama' suçundan tutuklanan Mehmet Fatih Tançalan ile hakkında gözaltı karar verilen ve halen aranan eşi Çağla Öz Tançalan'ın düğününde takılan altınlar, Muradiye ilçesinde polisin düzenlediği operasyonda bir evin odunluğunda valiz içerisinde ele geçirildi. Ev sahibi gözaltına alındı.

Sosyal medya fenomeni Çağla Öz ile 'Vanlı Kara Haydar' olarak tanınan Mehmet Fatih Tançalan'ın pazar günü Van'da düzenlenen düğününe ait görüntüler, sanal medyada geniş yankı buldu.

Görüntüler üzerine Van Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından soruşturma başlatıldı. Soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınan Mehmet Fatih Tançalan, 'Suçtan kaynaklanan malvarlığı değerlerini aklama' suçundan sevk edildiği nöbetçi sulh ceza hakimliğince tutuklandı.

Hakkında gözaltı kararı bulunan eşi Çağla Öz Tançalan'ın yakalanması için çalışmalar sürerken, hazırlanan MASAK raporunda ismi geçen annesi N.O. İstanbul'da, M.S.T. ise dün Muradiye ilçesinde gözaltına alındı.

Van Emniyet Müdürlüğü ekipleri, yaptıkları istihbari çalışmayla Muradiye ilçesinde bir adrese operasyon düzenledi. Adreste yapılan aramada, evin odunluk bölümünde bulunan bir valiz içerisinde Tançalan çiftinin düğününde takıldığı belirtilen altınlar ele geçirildi. Altınlara el konulurken, ev sahibi gözaltına alındı.

Van Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı'nın yürüttüğü soruşturma ise sürüyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: İHD: Darbelere karşı demokrasiyi savunuyoruz
content:
İnsan Hakları Derneği (İHD) İstanbul Şubesi, 12 Eylül 1980 askeri darbesinin 46. yılında, darbe bildirisinin okunduğu İstanbul Beyoğlu’ndaki TRT Radyo binası önünde açıklama yaptı.


“12 Eylül darbesinin 46. yılında darbelere karşı demokrasiyi savunuyoruz” pankartının taşındığı açıklamada basın metnini İHD Eş Genel Başkanı Oya Ersoy okudu.


Ersoy, 12 Eylül darbesinin ardından ağır insan hakları ihlallerinin yaşandığını belirterek, darbe sonrasında hazırlanan 1982 Anayasası’nın halen yürürlükte olduğuna dikkat çekti.


Benim için 80'ler ve 12 Eylül


Bugün  12:00


“OHAL uygulamalarının birçoğu varlığını sürdürüyor”


Türkiye’de olağanüstü hal (OHAL) dönemlerinde hayata geçirilen birçok uygulamanın kalıcılaştığını söyleyen Ersoy, şöyle konuştu:


“OHAL uygulamalarının birçoğunun halen varlığını sürdürdüğü ve birçok insan hakları ihlalinin yaşandığı bir dönemden geçiyoruz. Türkiye’yi 2002 yılından bu yana kesintisiz olarak yöneten AKP hükümeti darbelere karşı olduğunu ve sivil bir anayasa yapılması gerektiğini sürekli olarak vurgulamasına rağmen bu yönlü bir tavır ortaya koymak bir yana, anayasa hükümlerine uymaktan imtina etmiş, çıkarılan yasa ve yönetmeliklerle demokratik ortamın daha da daralmasına yol açan pratik içerisinde olmuştur.”


15 Temmuz 2016’daki darbe girişiminin ardından çıkarılan Kanun Hükmünde Kararnameleri (KHK) hatırlatan Ersoy, binlerce kamu görevlisinin ihraç edildiğini, belediyelere kayyım atandığını ve OHAL döneminde çıkarılan düzenlemelerin daha sonra yasalaştırıldığını söyledi.


“Geçici olağanüstü hal, kalıcı ve sürekli bir duruma dönüşmüştür. Darbe girişimi sırasında ve sonrasında yapılan yasal değişiklikler ile demokrasiyi tahkim etmek yerine otoriter rejim inşası tercih edilmiştir”

 ifadelerini kullandı.


Kürt meselesi ve çözüm süreci


Ersoy, Türkiye’de otoriterleşmenin artmasıyla birlikte Kürt meselesinin de uzun yıllar “inkarcı ve güvenlikçi” bir yaklaşımla ele alındığını söyledi.


Geçmişte sorunun demokratik yollarla çözümüne yönelik girişimlerin sonuçsuz kaldığını belirten Ersoy, Ekim 2024’te başladığını ifade ettiği yeni sürecin ise farklı gelişmelere sahne olduğunu kaydetti.


Abdullah Öcalan’ın 27 Şubat 2025’te yaptığı çağrının ardından PKK’nin kendisini feshettiğini hatırlatan Ersoy, TBMM’de siyasi partilerin temsilcilerinden oluşan bir komisyon kurulmasını, komisyon raporunun kamuoyuna açıklanmasını ve “çerçeve yasa” olarak anılan düzenlemenin Meclis Genel Kurulu’nda kabul edilmesini, eksikliklerine rağmen Kürt meselesinin çözümü açısından önemli gelişmeler olarak değerlendirdi.


“Muhalefete dönük baskılar arttı”


“Barış ve Demokratik Toplum Süreci” devam ederken muhalefet partilerine yönelik baskıların da arttığını söyleyen Ersoy, İHD’nin tüm antidemokratik uygulamalara karşı olduğunu belirtti.


Demokratik ve çoğulcu bir anayasa ihtiyacının sürdüğünü kaydederek, yeni bir anayasa yapılabilmesi için öncelikle temel hak ve özgürlükler alanında adımlar atılması gerektiğini ekledi.


“Cuntacılar tarafından hazırlanan bir anayasa ile yönetilen Türkiye’nin gerçek anlamda demokratik ve çoğulcu bir anayasaya olan ihtiyacı gün gibi ortadadır” diyen Ersoy, şöyle devam etti:


“Ancak devlet bu ülkede yaşayan halklar ve inançlar ile ‘barışmadan’, demokratik bir anayasa yapmak da pek olası görünmemektedir. Bu kapsamda ifade özgürlüğü, protesto hakkı, medya özgürlüğü, seçmen iradesine saygı, ulusal ve uluslararası mahkeme kararlarına saygı, yargı bağımsızlığı konularında gerekli yasal ve idari düzenlemeler yapıldıktan sonra sivil bir anayasa hazırlanmalıdır.”


12’sindeydi Eylül’ün


Bugün  00:00


Onarıcı adalet ve hafıza mekanları çağrısı


Ersoy, darbeciler ve darbe döneminde işlenen suçlarla ilgili etkin yargısal süreçlerin sürdürülmesi, mağdurların zararlarının giderilmesi ve onarıcı adalet mekanizmalarının kurulması çağrısı yaptı.


Diyarbakır Hapishanesi gibi darbe döneminin simge mekanlarının tarihsel gerçeklere uygun hafıza mekanlarına dönüştürülmesi gerektiğini de belirten Ersoy, sözlerini şöyle tamamladı:


“Hak ve özgürlüklere yönelik kısıtlamalara son verilmesini, çatışma çözümü girişimlerinin yanında demokratikleşme adımlarının atılmasını ve pozitif barışın sağlanması gerektiğini vurguluyor, bunun mücadelesini vereceğimizi yineliyoruz.”


(HA)

author: Unknown
title: Mıhçı: ‘Bearing the burden of peace’ matters most now - Part One
content:
Murat Mıhçı, a member of the Central Executive Board of the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party), said the framework law proposed as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process should not be viewed solely in terms of peace between Kurds and Turks. Describing the law as a historic opportunity for Turkey’s democratisation, Mıhçı said the first steps should include the release of ill prisoners and the creation of conditions in which political actors can freely engage in politics both inside and outside the country.


Mıhçı said mother-tongue rights, equal citizenship, stronger local government, civil society and the expansion of political space were among the key elements of democratic transformation. He added that abandoning policies of war would also bring significant economic and social benefits. Mıhçı said the process should reach a positive stage within two or three years and stressed that even the next six months would be critical.


The framework law is a historic opportunity for Turkey’s democratisation


Mıhçı said he regarded the framework law as highly significant for the history of the region, adding that the broad political consensus behind it was the result of a long struggle.


He argued that it would be wrong to view the law solely as a means of establishing peace between Kurds and Turks. 


Mıhçı said: “I attach great importance to this law. It is extremely significant for the history of our region. There may have been similar developments in the past, but this is the first time, in terms of the balance of forces in Parliament, that such a clear framework has emerged with the backing of almost 95 per cent of Turkey’s political representation. We consider this very important. It is also the result of an enormous struggle. I also believe it is wrong to view the framework law in this region solely as a matter of peace between Kurds and Turks. If this framework law genuinely succeeds, it will also mark one of the most important steps towards democratisation in the region. At the same time, it will significantly strengthen Turkey’s influence in the region and its surroundings under the current circumstances. A country that establishes peace within its own borders will also, in a sense, embrace communities whose relatives live abroad and those living in the diaspora. Turkey and the peoples of Turkey stand to emerge from this law stronger and with far greater gains.”


The law must be implemented without political manoeuvring


Mıhçı said the first step towards implementing the framework law was to put all of its provisions into practice sincerely and in full, stressing in particular the need to release ill prisoners and create conditions in which political actors could freely engage in political activity.


Mıhçı said: “The answer to what the first stage of the framework law should involve is clear: every provision it contains must be implemented sincerely and realistically, without political manoeuvring. First and foremost, ill prisoners must be released without delay. Conditions must also be created in which political actors can freely carry out their political activities both inside and outside the country. This would genuinely contribute both to democratisation in the region and to its political strengthening.”


Democratisation is an issue for all the peoples of Turkey


Mıhçı said the scope of the framework law was not sufficient to provide a democratic solution to the Kurdish question, but stressed that it was nevertheless important as a basis for a new process of democratisation.


He said a solution to the Kurdish question could not be considered separately from Turkey’s broader democratisation process, adding that issues such as mother-tongue rights, equal citizenship and local government should be addressed as part of this broader framework.


Mıhçı said Kurds had struggled for their linguistic and identity rights for many years, but stressed that the Kurdish movement and the DEM Party defended the rights not only of the Kurdish language but of all peoples and languages in the region.


Mıhçı said: “I believe the discussions in the media surrounding the Kurdish question have been stripped of their substance. It is not only Kurds who face problems; all the other peoples living in Turkey have their own issues as well. Democratisation concerns this entire country. If we are talking about the mother tongue, there are serious problems affecting all the mother tongues spoken in this …

author: Unknown
title: Amed residents: Let us honour our martyrs and their struggle
content:
The Association for Assistance, Solidarity, Unity and Culture for Families Who Lost Relatives in the Cradle of Civilisations (MEBYA-DER) organised a collective condolence gathering for those martyred in the freedom struggle at the Geterler Wedding and Conference Hall in the Rezan (Bağlar) district of Amed (Diyarbakır). Photographs of the martyrs and Abdullah Öcalan were displayed at the venue, where the gathering will continue for three days.


Thousands of people from different parts of the city visited the condolence gathering and offered their condolences to the families. Residents who spoke to ANF stressed the importance of honouring the memory of the martyrs and called on the public to attend the gathering.


 


It is now our duty to honour the martyrs


Emin Kılıç, who visited the condolence gathering, said the Kurdish people had reached an important stage in their struggle for freedom and that political struggle had now come to the fore. He said the martyrs had played a major role in bringing the struggle to this point and stressed that honouring their memory was a duty for everyone.


Kılıç said the scene at the condolence gathering in Bağlar was significant and continued: “Every struggle eventually reaches a stage in which the atmosphere is one of peace and the time has come for political struggle. We, the Kurdish people, have also reached that stage. We have moved beyond the stage of war and entered a period of political struggle. This means that now is the time to honour the martyrs of freedom, those who gave their lives to bring this cause to this point. The Kurdish people must regard it as their duty to honour the martyrs who brought this cause to this stage for as long as a single breath remains on these lands. What we are seeing today at Geterler Hall in the Bağlar district of Amed is the clearest expression of this. Many martyrs, people who gave their lives, are being commemorated here. Many Kurds will come to this gathering. No one can stand in the way of this any longer, and no one can prevent people from commemorating their own martyrs at this stage. It is a scene that really has to be witnessed in person. I believe anyone who comes here and sees it will gain tremendous spiritual strength. The scene today at the Geterler Wedding and Event Hall in Bağlar shows just how important and meaningful it is to honour the martyrs. Our call to our people is to come and take part in the commemoration of their martyrs.”


The Kurdish people want peace, not revenge


Kılıç also drew attention to the calls for peace made by families who lost loved ones in the freedom struggle. Kılıç said: “We constantly hear from mothers whose hearts have been broken, mothers who sacrificed their children for this cause. They say, ‘We want peace.’ Sometimes, on the other side, on the state side, we constantly hear statements such as, ‘We will take revenge, we will avenge our children.’ The Kurdish people, however, say, ‘Enough, enough, enough. We do not want revenge either. Our hearts have already been torn apart, our children have been taken from us. Let no one else lose their life. Let mothers’ tears fall only as smiles upon the faces of their children. We want peace.’ Those we have lost are gone. Let us not suffer any more losses. We want peace. Our only demand is peace.”


I hope mothers never have to cry again


Mecit Yılmaz said those martyred in the freedom struggle had left the Kurdish people with the hope of a life in freedom. Yılmaz also said: “First of all, I offer my condolences to all the people of Kurdistan and to all our families. They were martyred to give us a life of freedom. They were martyred to give us a free Kurdistan. I bow with respect before their memory and offer my condolences to their families. I hope mothers never have to cry again. I hope no mother has to shed another tear and that the days ahead are filled with peace and beauty.”


Öcalan is the key to a solution


Yılmaz said Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom was essential for the Peace and Democratic Society Process to lead to a lasting solution. Yılmaz continued: “Of course, for this to happen, Abdullah Öcalan must be free and able to take part in a life of freedom. No one can deceive us: we are free to the extent that Mr. Öcalan is free. We can participate in democratic life to the extent that Mr. Öcalan can participate in democratic life. Mr. Öcalan wants to build the democratic nation, and within that democratic nation he wants a free Kurdistan and …

author: Unknown
title: The political economy of electoral choices in Kurdistan
content:
Reading the economy in Kurdistan solely through relations of production and consumption means overlooking the heart of the issue. For more than a century, the economic structure has been shaped as an extension of a state policy aimed at breaking the political will of the Kurdish people. Patterns of capital accumulation, the system of land ownership, the distribution of public investment and the organisation of the labour market were never “neutral” technical decisions. They were direct political choices. Discussing the political economy of Kurdistan therefore means examining the tools through which the regime of denial continues to operate today.


The Kurdish Freedom Movement has consistently argued that the conventional discourse of development, “bringing investment” to the region, “incentive packages” and “development agencies”, addresses the consequences rather than the source of the problem. Poverty does not stem from Kurdistan’s “underdevelopment”, but from a deliberate colonial division of labour. Kurdistan has historically been assigned the role of a source of cheap labour and raw materials and an area of low-intensity production. This order has been sustained through the transfer of economic benefits in return for political loyalty.


The historical framework of the colonial-capitalist relationship


Economic policies pursued in Kurdistan since the establishment of the Republic were shaped through alliances between the state and local centres of power based on tribal leaders and notables. The deliberate failure to implement land reform, the preservation of large landholdings and the elevation of these groups to the status of “representatives” in the eyes of the state effectively froze class contradictions in favour of the central state rather than the Kurdish movement. The class conflict between poor peasants and large landowners was thus suppressed within the broader national question.


Village evacuations and forced displacement from the 1980s onwards became the most destructive chapter in this historical process. The evacuation of thousands of villages was not merely a military measure; it was also an economic operation that fundamentally destroyed the region’s relations of production. Dispossession from land and property and the forced descent into urban poverty formed part of a systematic strategy aimed at dismantling the socio-economic foundations of resistance. The concentration of Kurdish poverty in working-class neighbourhoods across Turkey’s major cities today is a direct legacy of this process.


Local capital, the centralised state and relations of dependency


The past two decades have seen the emergence of a distinct layer of local capital in the region, particularly through construction, transport, energy and public procurement. Yet this section of capital does not represent a productive or autonomous model of accumulation. Instead, it has largely developed into a rent-seeking class dependent on the central government’s system of trustee-appointed administrations and public contracts, sustained in return for political loyalty. This structure has systematically targeted cooperative and solidarity-based economic initiatives with organic ties to the popular movement. Municipal companies taken over through the appointment of trustees, women’s cooperatives and ecology-based production networks are among the clearest examples.


The trustee economy


Participatory budgeting processes were abolished in municipalities taken over by government-appointed trustees from 2016 onwards, while public resources were channelled to contracting groups close to the central government. This was not merely a political intervention; it amounted to a form of class-based economic dispossession.


This picture once again demonstrates that the mechanisms of capitalist modernity in Kurdistan do not operate independently of the nation-state apparatus. On the contrary, it reinforces the argument that they sustain themselves by becoming intertwined with the coercive apparatus of a centralised state. Proposals that simply call for “waiting for the free market to reach the region” or “attracting foreign capital” therefore do little more than reproduce the same relations of dependency.

author: Unknown
title: Şahin: Portraying the Freedom Movement as anti-Alevi is propaganda
content:
Writer Mehmet Şahin assessed the Kurdish Freedom Movement’s relationship with the Alevi community and the struggle waged between 1986 and 1993 in and around Maraş (Mereş), Malatya (Meletî), Adıyaman (Semsûr) and Antep (Dîlok).


Şahin’s book Engizek’ten Esintiler (Echoes from Engizek) examines the guerrilla struggle and attempts at liquidation during this period. He said the book was not simply an account of the guerrilla movement but also shed light on the sociological structure of the region.


The book is not simply a guerrilla narrative


Şahin said his memoir-biography Engizek’ten Esintiler sheds light on an important period of social history, focusing on events between 1986 and 1993 in Malatya, Adıyaman, Gurgum (Maraş) and the surrounding areas, a region referred to as Tolhildan Province.


Şahin said: “Engizek’ten Esintiler, a memoir-biography, goes beyond a conventional guerrilla narrative and sheds light on an important period of social history. Although the Freedom Movement has its own account of these historic lands, it is not widely known among the broader public. This work seeks to address that gap.


The book offers a multifaceted analysis of both the difficulties faced and the extraordinary struggle waged by the Kurdistan Freedom guerrillas between 1986 and 1993 in Malatya, Adıyaman, Gurgum (Maraş) and the surrounding areas, which were defined as Tolhildan Province.”


Şahin said he wrote the book while in prison and that its primary purpose was to honour those who lost their lives in the Kurdish people’s struggle for existence and freedom.


He said the book also examines the sociological structure of the region’s population through the relationship between the guerrillas and the people. Şahin added that its assessment of the region’s socio-cultural fabric also offers perspectives relevant to the present day.


Alevis were the first to open their doors to the Kurdish Freedom guerrillas


Şahin described Malatya (Meletî), Adıyaman (Semsûr) and Maraş (Mereş) as a distinctive geography in which both Kurdish and Turkish Alevism developed, noting that the region had also been the scene of historic uprisings and resistance.


Şahin continued: “These regions are also a distinctive geography where Turkish and Kurdish Alevism took root and developed. These lands lie at the heart of an ancient geography where the Celali uprisings, led by Baba İshak, emerged with a tradition of rebellion. They were later the lands where figures such as Pir Sultan waged struggles for rights and freedom against oppression and inequality. These uprisings may have been defeated, but they did not submit to injustice. This spirit of struggle gave rise to an extraordinary legacy of experience and resistance. Despite relentless attempts to suppress and destroy it, whenever an opportunity arose, it stood up again and took its place in the struggle.”


Şahin recalled that Kızılbaş and Alevi communities, rooted in a longstanding faith and philosophical tradition, had historically been regarded as a threat by ruling classes. He drew attention to the treatment of Kurdish Alevis in Koçgirî and Dersim during the Republican era. Şahin said:  “This tradition of domination unfortunately became deeply embedded in the very foundations of the Republic of Turkey. The nature of the genocide carried out against Kurdish Alevis in Koçgirî during the establishment of the Republic and later in Dersim is well known. Of course, they were not subjected to these brutal practices solely because they were Alevi. They were also targeted by a policy driven by hostility because they were Kurdish and persisted in their struggle for identity. The Republic that emerged from the remnants of the Ottoman Empire constructed its enemies around three Ks: Kurds, Kızılbaş and Communists.


Because of these historical realities, the Alevi population of the region did not experience repression and discriminatory policies only in the 1990s. The provocations and attempted massacres against Alevis in Maraş in December 1978, as well as in Malatya and Çorum, remain as vivid as yesterday in the memory of the people of the region.”


Şahin said repression intensified as the Kurdistan Freedom Movement established a presence in the region in the 1990s, while historical fears were revived and exploited. title: Mencî Akbaş: We will follow in the footsteps of our martyrs
content:
For the past two weeks, the identities of guerrillas who fell as martyrs on different dates and in different regions were announced.


Condolence gatherings were held for the fallen guerrillas in many places, particularly in the provinces of Kurdistan. Aryen Sozdar (Mizgîn Akbaş), a guerrilla who fell as a martyr in Heftanîn on 27 July 2019, was also commemorated at a condolence gathering held in Amed. Hundreds of citizens, as well as the families of martyrs, attended the gathering.


Mencî Akbaş, the mother of Aryen Sozdar, said she was proud of her daughter and added: “We will follow in the footsteps of our martyrs to the last drop of our blood. We will not cry for them; we have given them our word. I said I had two conditions: either betrayal or martyrdom. I will never accept betrayal. I hold my head high and am proud of her martyrdom. I do not cry for my martyr. Our martyrs are immortal. We will follow in the footsteps of our martyrs to the last drop of our blood. All of us, even the baby in the cradle, will follow in the footsteps of our martyrs. We will not follow traitors or dishonorable people; we will not sell ourselves for three pennies or worldly possessions. Even if they offered us the whole world, we would not sell our honor or dignity."


Akbaş continued: “I would sacrifice myself for all our martyrs; every one of them is the light of my eyes. We hold our heads high and are proud of every one of them. We will follow in their footsteps until our last breath. Let no one try to trap us, let them not distort our interviews, and let them stop betraying us; enough is enough. Those who think they can deceive us by talking about peace think that Kurds are still the Kurds of the past.


They cannot deceive us; while they were on their way there, we were already on our way back. We are strong in every sense, and we will continue on this path to the last drop of our blood. The Turkish state and foreign powers can no longer deceive us or manipulate us. We have become one across the four parts of Kurdistan. I call on the families of the martyrs: there is no benefit in crying or mourning. They should stand tall and support one another. We must stand strong across all four parts of Kurdistan. Crying and mourning will gain us nothing. Let no one cry; we hold our heads high, and we are proud of our martyrs.”

author: Unknown
title: Sezgin Tanrıkulu’ndan 12 Eylül açıklaması: ‘Darbeciler gitti, siyasal düzenleri sürüyor’
content:
Elif Ekin Saltık [email protected]

Yeni Parti Diyarbakır Milletvekili Sezgin Tanrıkulu, 12 Eylül askeri darbesinin üzerinden geçen 46 yılın ardından yazılı bir açıklama yaptı. Darbecilerin fiziken gitmesine rağmen anayasasının, kurdukları kurumların ve yarattıkları siyasal düzenin ortadan kaldırılmadığına dikkat çeken Tanrıkulu, geçmişte yaşanan acıların altını çizdi. Geriye hafızalarda yalnızca Diyarbakır Cezaevi, Mamak ve Metris’te yaşanan vahşetin kaldığını belirten Tanrıkulu; işkencelerin, kayıpların, faili meçhul cinayetlerin ve gözaltında yaşanan ağır hak ihlallerinin unutulmadığını ifade etti.

Meselenin yalnızca 12 Eylül dönemiyle sınırlı kalmadığını belirten Tanrıkulu, darbe kavramının günümüzdeki yansımalarına dikkat çekti. Darbelerin sadece tank ve topla yapılmayacağını vurgulayan Tanrıkulu, seçilmiş belediye başkanlarının görevden alınarak yerlerine kayyım atanmasını ve siyasi partilerin yönetimlerinin yargı eliyle değiştirilmek istenmesini de açıkça birer darbe olarak değerlendirdi.

Bugün iktidar eliyle yürütülen bu uygulamaların, 12 Eylül zihniyetinin doğrudan bir devamı olduğunu söyleyen Tanrıkulu, mevcut tabloyu şu sözlerle özetledi: “Sendikalar açık ama grevler yasak. Meclis açık ama belediyeler abluka altında. Cezaevlerinde ise hâlâ insanlık dışı koşullar hüküm sürüyor.”

Türkiye’de sandığın ve seçimin var olduğunu ancak seçilmiş yöneticilerin hiçbir güvencesinin bulunmadığını belirten Tanrıkulu, gözaltılar, baskılar ve tehditler aracılığıyla serbest seçimli yerel demokrasinin, yargı eliyle seçim garantili bir otokrasiye dönüştürüldüğünü dile getirdi.

Her dönemde ve her koşulda darbelere karşı çıktıklarını hatırlatan Tanrıkulu, “12 Eylül darbesinden, 15 Temmuz darbe girişimine her türlü darbe girişimine karşıyız ve karşı koymaya devam edeceğiz” dedi.

Tanrıkulu sözlerini şöyle sonlandırdı: “Unutmadık, unutmayacağız. 12 Eylülcülerden toptan hesap soracağımız gün gelecek; bu zihniyeti Türkiye’den söküp atacağız.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Keine Besetzer*innen ins Gefängnis (Thessaloniki Edition)
content:
Informationen zum Gerichtsverfahren wegen der Räumung des Treffpunkts („Steki“) hinter der Chemie-Fakultät („Chimiko“) in Thessaloniki 2022.


Gerichtsverfahren kosten Geld. Darum unterstützt die betroffenen Genoss**innen in Thessaloniki über ihren Firefund!


https://www.firefund.net/stekistoxhmiko2022


Der Steki „Viologiko“


Mit Besetzungen ging schon immer ein Hauch von Freiheit für radikale Bewegungen einher. Als Treffpunkte, Orte der politischen Auseinandersetzung und Strukturen für Projekte waren sie dem Staat stets ein Dorn im Auge und standen fortwährend im Fokus der Repression. So auch das „Steki“ im „Viologiko“ (Biologie-Fakultät), welches 1987 von Studenten*innen besetzt wurde. Während der gesamten Zeit setzte es sich aus sehr vielfältigen Gruppen zusammen, die mit ihren unterschiedlichen Tätigkeiten und verschiedenen Aktionsweisen koexistierten, deren Hauptanliegen jedoch stets eine solidarische und selbstorganisierte Praxis waren. Im Laufe der Jahre beherbergte der Ort studentische Gruppen, Theater- und Radio-Projekte, Buchhandlungen, Cafés, Gemeinschaftsküchen, es fanden Buchvorstellungen, Filmvorführungen, Griechischkurse für Migranten*innen und Geflüchtete sowie Selbstverteidigungskurse statt. Außerdem war das „Steki“ von zentraler Bedeutung für die lokale und überregionale DIY-Musikszene. Es war ein Ort politischer und sozialer Kämpfe – von Studentenprotesten über Proteste von Wehrdienstverweigerern bis hin zur Organisierung politischer Gefangener. Als aktiver Treffpunkt und Ort der Begegnung im Zentrum der Stadt war es eine lebendige Zelle innerhalb der Universität.


Die Räumung


Nach der Wahl der rechts-konservativen Nea Demokratia-Regierung und der Durchsetzung ihres politischen Law-and-Order Dogmas im Jahr 2019 begann sofort ein umfassender Angriff auf die besetzten Räume, der durch ein Ultimatum des amtierenden Ministers für Bürgerschutz, Michalis Chrysochoidis, angekündigt wurde. Zugleich war dieses Ultimatum Auslöser für einen Kampf zur Verteidigung des Zentrums. Während das Zusammenspiel aus aktivem Widerstand und dem Beginn der Covid-19-Pandemie das politische Programm der Regierung zur Zerschlagung sämtlicher Besetzungen vorübergehend zum Erliegen brachte, wurden auch die Bemühungen der Regierung, durch einen neuen Gesetzentwurf eine Universitätspolizei einzuführen und die Universitäten als Treffpunkte linker ‚Keimzellen‘ so zu entpolitisieren, durch die Studentenproteste von 2021 vorerst vereitelt. Es wäre jedoch ein Irrglaube zu denken, der Staat würde jemals vergessen und anfangen zu dulden, was er als potenzielle Bedrohung seiner Ordnung ansieht. So fand die Räumung der Besetzung schlussendlich in den frühen Morgenstunden des Neujahrstages 2022 statt.


Die Antwort – ein neuer Treffpunkt hinter der Chemie-Fakultät


Bereits im Vorfeld fanden angesichts der drohenden Räumung des „Steki“ offene Versammlungen zu dessen Verteidigung statt, an denen eine Vielzahl von Personen teilnahmen. Als Reaktion auf die Räumung wurde , auf Beschluss der Versammlung vom 10.01.2022, ein Labor hinter der Chemie-Fakultät besetzt, mit dem Ziel, einen neuen Treffpunkt zu schaffen, der den Bedürfnissen der politischen Kämpfe der Stadt gerecht würde. Ein wesentliches Kriterium für die Wahl des Ortes war seine Lage innerhalb des Universitätsgeländes als Akt des Widerstands gegen die Sterilisation und Entpolitisierung der Universitäten und gegen innerstädtische Gentrifizierungsprozesse. Ein weiteres Kriterium für diese Wahl bestand in der simplen Tatsache, dass das betreffende Gebäude ungenutzt war und durch ein neues Projekt wieder zum Leben erweckt werden sollte.


In den zwei Tagen seines Bestehens wurde die Besetzung von einer großen Anzahl solidarischer Menschen unterstützt, die während dieses kurzen Zeitraums Veranstaltungen organisierten und Arbeiten durchführten, um den Ort seinen Bedürfnissen entsprechend funktionsfähig zu machen.


Der Ablauf der Räumung des neuen „Steki“


In den frühen Morgenstunden des 12. Januar wurde jedoch auch dieser neue Treffpunkt geräumt. An der Räumung waren verschiedene Polizeieinheiten innerhalb und um den Universitätscampus herum beteiligt. Zunächst wurde das Gebäude von Einheiten der Bereitschaftspolizei, der OPKE und von Zivis umzingelt, die begannen, gegen die Türen und Wände zu schlagen und die Menschen im Inneren aufforderten, das Gebäude zu verlassen. Die Menschen drinnen entschieden sich jedoch, das Gebäude nicht aufzugeben und die Besetzung zu verteidigen …

title: [Χανιά] Τοποθέτηση ετοιμοπόλεμων αντιπυραυλικών συστημάτων Patriot εντός κατοικημένης περιοχής
content:
Αναδημοσίευση από το Athens Indymedia

Δημοσιεύουμε φωτογραφικό υλικό από οικόπεδο στην περιοχή Λειβάδια των Χανίων, ανάμεσα στο περιαστικό δάσος του Αγίου Ματθαίου και το Μ.Α.Ι.Χ. Το συγκεκριμένο οικόπεδο φαίνεται να ανήκει στον ελληνικό στρατό, και εντός του βρίσκονται τοποθετημένες 3 συστοιχίες του αντιπυραυλικού συστήματος Patriot. Και οι 3 συστοιχίες έχουν τοποθετηθεί ώστε να είναι προσανατολισμένες προς τη βάση του ΝΑΤΟ (και δεν έχουν αποθηκευτεί απλώς).

Το συγκεκριμένο οικόπεδο βρίσκεται εντός κατοικημένης περιοχής, λίγα χιλιόμετρα μακριά από τη νατοϊκή βάση. Η παρούσα δημοσίευση τεκμηριώνει πως τα υλικά του πολέμου είναι ήδη τοποθετημένα στις πόλεις, τις περιοχές, τις γειτονιές μας. Τέτοια οπλικά συστήματα θα είναι τα πρώτα που θα εμπλακούν σε ενδεχόμενο κλιμάκωσης, και βέβαια, θα αποτελέσουν και αυτά (εκτός από τη βάση του ΝΑΤΟ), υποψήφιους στόχους.

Τα Patriot έχουν τοποθετηθεί εκεί από τον Μάρτη, όταν ξεκίνησε επίσημα ο πόλεμος στο Ιράν, και έκτοτε δεν έχουν μετακινηθεί. Οι φωτογραφίες έχουν ληφθεί στα τέλη του Ιούλη, αποδεικνύοντας την παρουσία αυτών των συστημάτων πολύ νωρίτερα από τον πρόσφατο επικοινωνιακό ντόρο περί μεταφοράς Patriot από την Κάρπαθο στη Σούδα, μετά την «αποκάλυψη» από δυτικά media ότι το Ιράν σχεδίαζε επιθέσεις σε ευρωπαϊκά εδάφη.

Την κρίση του καπιταλισμού τη χειρίζονται πολεμικά. Η εικόνα των Patriot μέσα σε κατοικημένη ζώνη έρχεται να συμπληρώσει μια συνθήκη που χαρακτηρίζεται από την ακρίβεια για την κάλυψη των καθημερινών αναγκών, την αστυνομική βία που οδήγησε στον θάνατο τον Κώστα Μανιουδάκη (01/09/2023) και τον Ασράφ (26/08/2026), το δηλητήριο του φασισμού, τη δολοφονική «μεταναστευτική πολιτική» στις συνοριακές γραμμές θανάτου, τα ενεργειακά mega-project και τα καρτέλ της ανάπτυξης, που προσδένουν το νησί στο γενοκτονικό καθεστώς του Ισραήλ.

ΝΑ ΟΞΥΝΟΥΜΕ ΤΟΝ ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΟ ΤΑΞΙΚΟ ΠΟΛΕΜΟ

title: Iranian female trainer sentenced to prison
content:
Nergis Haydari, a fitness and bodybuilding trainer in the city of Izeh who was detained by the Intelligence Organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps during protests in Iran in January, was sentenced to five years in prison by the Revolutionary Court in Ahvaz on charges of “engaging in activities against national security.”


Nergis Haydari was also sanctioned for failing to comply with mandatory hijab rules during sports activities and for sharing these activities with the public.

Η Επιστροφή της Άρτεμης”: Μια συμμετοχική παράσταση Θεάτρου Φόρουμ από την Ομάδα Κοινωνικού Θεάτρου Πολιτών Αργολίδας «Οι Τζίτζικες».


12 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026


Τέχνη και συμμετοχή για τη φωνή της Αργολίδας – Αρκαδίας και τα βουνά τους.


Η Άρτεμις, μια νέα δασκάλα που επιστρέφει στο χωριό της κάπου στο Αρτεμίσιο όρος ως νεοδιόριστη, έρχεται αντιμέτωπη με ένα μεγάλο αναπτυξιακό σχέδιο που απειλεί να αλλάξει ριζικά τον τόπο όπου μεγάλωσε. Καθώς οι κάτοικοι διχάζονται ανάμεσα στις υποσχέσεις οικονομικού οφέλους και στην προστασία του φυσικού περιβάλλοντος, η ίδια αναζητά συμμάχους και τρόπους δράσης απέναντι σε αποφάσεις που φαίνεται να λαμβάνονται ερήμην της τοπικής κοινωνίας.


Η Επιστροφή της Άρτεμης είναι μια συμμετοχική παράσταση με αφετηρία τις σύγχρονες κοινωνικές και περιβαλλοντικές συγκρούσεις που αναδύονται γύρω από την εγκατάσταση βιομηχανικών αιολικών πάρκων σε βουνά της Αργολίδας και της Αρκαδίας. Μέσα από προσωπικές αφηγήσεις, ντοκουμέντα, μαρτυρίες κατοίκων, συλλογικές μνήμες, επιστημονικά δεδομένα και μυθολογικούς συμβολισμούς, η παράσταση συνδέει το παρελθόν με το παρόν και θέτει ερωτήματα για τη σχέση ανθρώπου, φύσης και τις αντιφάσεις της “πράσινης ανάπτυξης”.


Μέσα από μια σειρά συμμετοχικών εργαστηρίων και δημιουργικών συναντήσεων, πολίτες της Αργολίδας συνεργάστηκαν για να δημιουργήσουν μια πολυφωνική σκηνική σύνθεση με θέμα τα αιολικά στα βουνά της περιοχής, αξιοποιώντας εργαλεία του κοινωνικού θεάτρου, του Θεάτρου των Καταπιεσμένων και του θεάτρου τεκμηρίωσης. Ειδικότερα, η παράσταση έχει τη δομή του Θεάτρου Φόρουμ, όπου η παράσταση δεν τελειώνει με το χειροκρότημα: οι θεατές καλούνται να γίνουν «δρώντες-θεατές», να παρέμβουν στη δράση και να αναζητήσουν συλλογικά πιθανές απαντήσεις στο κεντρικό ερώτημα της παράστασης:


Ποιος αποφασίζει για το μέλλον ενός τόπου;


Η Επιστροφή της Άρτεμης αντιμετωπίζει το θέατρο ως τόπο δημοκρατικής συνάντησης, καλλιτεχνικής έρευνας και ενεργού πολιτειότητας. Μέσα από τη συμμετοχική της μορφή επιχειρεί να μετατρέψει μια τοπική περιβαλλοντική σύγκρουση που απασχολεί τα ορεινά χωριά της Αργολίδας σε ένα οικουμενικό ερώτημα για τις σχέσεις εξουσίας, την οικολογική δικαιοσύνη και τη δυνατότητα των πολιτών να συνδιαμορφώνουν τον κόσμο στον οποίο ζουν.


Επινόηση συλλογικής δραματουργίας και ερμηνεία: Κωνσταντίνα Δελογιάννη, Ρίτα Ζικήδου, Χριστίνα Ζώνιου, Χριστίνα Κλείδωνα, Βασίλης Κλησιάρης, Ιωάννα Κούνα, Εύη Μπούσια, Μαρία Παναγιωτίδου, Σούλα Παναγιώτου, Χρυσούλα Τουρλούκη, Γεώργιος Φραγκάκης, Αφροδίτη Χατζηαβάνογλου.


Καλλιτεχνική και επιστημονική επιμέλεια: Χριστίνα Ζώνιου, διδάσκουσα στο Τμήμα Θεατρικών Σπουδών και Βασίλης Κλησιάρης, θεατροπαιδαγωγός.


Οργάνωση παραγωγής: Ρίτα Ζηκίδου, θεατροπαιδαγωγός.


Η παράσταση αποτελεί αποτέλεσμα συνεργασίας της Ομάδας Κοινωνικού Θεάτρου Πολιτών Αργολίδας «Οι Τζίτζικες», με το Κίνημα Πολιτών «Ελεύθερα Αργολικά Βουνά», το Τμήμα Θεατρικών Σπουδών του …

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 12 septembre
content:
Le 12 septembre, l'éphéméride des luttes s'en prend aux fascistes et aux franquistes, tentant d'en finir avec leurs chefs et leurs représentants à travers le monde. Un sain hobby.


1880 :

 A Paris, parution du premier numéro du journal 'La Révolution Sociale'. Selon l'éphéméride anarchiste, "

Comment un journal anarchiste hebdomadaire en vient à être créé de toutes pièces et financé avec les fonds secrets du Préfet de police de Paris, Louis Andrieux, pour mieux infiltrer le mouvement anarchiste et éventuellement jouer la provocation...


Utilisant pour cela un agent infiltré (Egide Spilleux), qui prétend que l'argent provient d'une riche anglaise sympathisante, il arrive à abuser Louise Michel qui donne sa caution morale au journal. Cinquante-six numéros paraissent jusqu'au

18 septembre

 1881, avant que certain compagnons ne s'étonnent de la désinvolture avec laquelle le journal publie leurs noms et adresses.

"


1927 :

 A Paris, l'anarchiste italien Sergio di Modugno abat le vice-consul fasciste italien à Paris d'une balle de revolver.


1929 :

 Au Paraguay, le gouvernement décrète l'état de siège du fait de l'émergence d'un mouvement communiste dans le pays.


1948 :

 A Donostia (San Sebastian, Pays Basque), "une tentative d'attentat anarchiste aérien contre Franco a lieu. Après l'achat en France, par l'anarchiste espagnol Laureano Cerrada, d'un petit avion de tourisme qu'ils chargent de bombes, trois compagnons espagnols prennent place dans l'avion (le pilote Primitivo Gómez, José Pérez et Antonio Ortiz) dans le but de bombarder la tribune du Club nautique d'où Franco et les hauts dignitaires du régime doivent présider les régates. Mais le petit avion est rapidement intercepté par quatre avions de chasse espagnols. Son air inoffensif lui sauve la mise et lui évite d'être abattu. Il parvient à rejoindre la France.


Cela donnera lieu à un échange diplomatique entre la France et l'Espagne et à l'interrogatoire par la police française du pilote et du propriétaire (officiel) de l'avion, l'anarchiste français Georges Fontenis.

"


De nouveau extrait de

l'éphéméride anarchiste


1970 :

 A la base de Dawson Field en Jordanie, le FPLP fait sauter trois avions vides détournés quelques jours plus tôt. C'est l'un des événements qui déclenchera 'Septembre Noir'.


1977 :

 A Johannesburg en Afrique du Sud, Steve Biko, un leader des mobilisations antiracistes et anti-apartheid, meurt en prison après avoir été battu et torturé.


2016 :

 A Lannion, dans les Côtes-D'Armor, un engin incendiaire explose contre la permanence du Parti Socialiste.


2017 :

 Lors de la première grande manifestation contre la Loi Travail numéro 2, des affrontements ont notamment lieu à Paris, où sortent quelques molotov, mais aussi à Nantes et dans une moindre mesure à Lyon, tandis que des centaines de milliers de personnes sont dans la rue partout dans le pays.


2018 :

 A Scorzé près de Venise, un hangar contenant le bureau et l'entrepôt d'un élevage de visons

sont incendiés

, faisant environ 300.000 euros de dégâts à l'industrie de la fourrure, sans qu'aucun animal ne soit blessé.


Voir aussi

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 12 septembre.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Malvinas en clave electoral
content:
El presidente Milei pasó de admirar a Margaret Thatcher y conceder que los habitantes de la isla eran quienes tenían derecho a decidir su futuro, a revestirse de un oportuno nacionalismo y llamar a la unidad nacional para defender la soberanía.


Javier Milei y su admirada Margaret Thatcher


Presionado por el declive de su imagen y gestión de gobierno, Milei dio una voltereta en el aire desempolvando la “causa nacional” por Malvinas. Trata así de recuperar iniciativa, junto con otra serie de medidas, luego de la fuerte derrota política del 6 de agosto pasado. Todo en clave electoral.


“Malvinas. La verdad o la mística nacional” es el título de un texto anónimo que escribiera en junio de 1982 el sociólogo Carlos Alberto Brocato, y que quienes nos oponíamos a la aventura militar de la dictadura genocida del 76 ayudamos a distribuir. El texto desnudaba la maniobra de un régimen dictatorial que trataba de alargar su dominio cuando ya era evidente que llegaba a su fin dejando miles de muertos y desaparecidos, cientos de niños secuestrados y un país extenuado. En paralelo, el texto, un verdadero manifiesto filosófico-político, cuestionaba el chauvinismo de buena parte de la sociedad, que ingenuamente caía en la trampa nacionalista.


El dictador genocida Leopoldo Fortunato Galtieri


En un giro copernicano el presidente Milei pasó de admirar a Margaret Thatcher y conceder que los habitantes de la isla eran quienes tenían derecho a decidir su futuro, a revestirse de un oportuno nacionalismo y llamar a la unidad nacional para defender la soberanía. No son pocos los que hablan de una “galtierización” del presidente, equiparando las maniobras políticas de dos regímenes, de naturaleza diferente, que coincidían en manipular el sentimiento popular por un causa justa, creyendo contar con el apoyo de EE.UU.


Atendiendo la emergencia


“Nacionalismo de emergencia”, bautizó el periodista Eduardo Van der Kooy (Clarín 6/9) a la movida malvinera del presidente Milei, complementaria una serie de medidas económico-políticas por las que busca volver a ocupar el centro de la escena política. Tanto frente a la sociedad como dentro de su propio gobierno.


Fernando Cerimedo detenido en Bolivia


Es que la economía no crece como se esperaba (el crecimiento del PBI se estima ahora en 2.1, cuando se proyectaba un 3.5); el endeudamiento y morosidad de las familias semejó a un baldazo de agua helada, mientras que la política antiinflacionaria tardó más de lo pensado en bajar de 2% y está lejos de empezar con cero como prometiera el presidente, mientras que las causas por corrupción escalaron con el caso Adorni y ahora con el del agente internacional Cerimedo. Todo aporta a la tendencial caída de la imagen presidencial y de la gestión de su gobierno, más allá de recuperaciones momentáneas. Se encendieron las alarmas y ya nadie puede asegurar su reelección. Las posibilidades de un mileísmo sin Milei comenzaron entonces a cobrar fuerza.


Oportunismo político


Este es el contexto general en el cual debe inscribirse la voltereta presidencial con el cual quiere aprovechar los dichos del presidente Donald Trump, que cuestionó la falta de colaboración de Gran Bretaña en su intento de recuperar la libre navegación en el estrecho de Ormuz y su negativa a aumentar el gasto militar para financiar a la OTAN, y amenazó con abandonar la tradicional neutralidad de EE.UU. y quitarle el apoyo en el caso Malvinas.


Milei intenta con esta maniobra subirse al sentimiento nacionalista que despertó el épico triunfo futbolero frente a los ingleses y el letrero que levantaron los jugadores al finalizar el partido. Estos son los antecedentes inmediatos que despertaron un sentimiento nacional como hace tiempo no se veía. El sustento de lo que pasó el 6 de agosto con la fuerte derrota política, dentro y fuera del Congreso, por la Ley de inviolabilidad de la propiedad privada. Un reverdecer de la conciencia colectiva, un acto de dignidad nacional, de carácter defensivo frente a la idea de que con la Ley de Tierras “La patria estaba en peligro”.


Foto:

Mat ((i))


Según la consultora Aresco la maniobra se apoya en datos concretos: el 83.6% de los consultados cree que se debe sostener con firmeza el reclamo de soberanía (estos datos llegan al 81 entre los votantes de LLA y al 92.1 entre los del peronismo) y apenas un 10.3% coincide con los dichos de Milei del año pasado. Claro que otras encuestas muestran que más del 60% de los entrevistados caracterizan esta mutación …

author: Unknown
title: [Livre] Révolution et Contre-Révolution dans la Région Espagnole des Années Trente
content:
/

PDF

 /


Présentation


La première partie de ce travail est initialement parue en espagnol dans la revue Comunismo 66 du Groupe Communiste Internationaliste (

GCI

) en février 2017. Bien que l'équipe qui a produit ce matériel ait préparé sa suite dans les numéros suivants de cette revue, une série de circonstances et de ruptures ultérieures ont interrompu le planning prévu. Plus de cinq ans après, une bonne partie des militants qui composaient l'équipe ont décidé de reprendre cette tâche importante, considérant qu'elle représente une contribution qualitative au bilan que notre classe a forgé de cet épisode historique extraordinaire. Cette seconde partie fut publiée par les Proletarios internacionalistas dans la revue Revolución 2 en septembre 2023.


Certains camarades s'interrogent sur l'utilité que peut avoir un tel matériel dans le présent : un bilan d'un processus qui s'est déroulé il y a presque un siècle et sur lequel on a écrit ad nauseam. Tout ce qui est important du point de vue du prolétariat révolutionnaire n'a-t-il pas déjà été dit

 

? N'y a-t-il pas des questions et des problèmes actuels beaucoup plus importants qui requièrent nos efforts et qui auront plus d'impact, ou du moins qui seront mieux accueillis dans notre communauté de lutte, par rapport à ce «

 

mammouth

 

» sur la lutte en Espagne dans les années 1930

 

? Nous ne nions pas qu'il existe des questions actuelles d'une grande pertinence qui sont abordées aujourd'hui au sein des minorités révolutionnaires et d'autres sections de notre classe. Nous n'y sommes pas étrangers et y participons à différents niveaux.


L'antifascisme ne continue-t-il pas à avoir une force hégémonique partout, acquérant une nouvelle vigueur et renforçant la démocratie, le politicisme, la polarisation entre la gauche et la droite, en enrôlant même les prolétaires dans telle ou telle guerre

 

? Le gestionnisme n'est-il pas l'une des voies par excellence face à la crise de la valorisation du capital

 

? L'État du Rojava, la guerre Ukraine-Russie, l'utilisation constante d'un moindre mal, l'épouvantail du fascisme, le possibilisme, l'apologie de la prise des centres de production par les travailleurs comme objectif, l'anti-autoritarisme comme monopole du pouvoir dans les mains de l'État… Le bilan présenté ici ne fait qu'approfondir la critique de ces idéologies et d'autres qui restent aujourd'hui un pilier de l'ordre social. Leur pertinence et leur importance sont irréfutables.


Certes, la critique révolutionnaire a déjà passé en revue ces forces de l'ennemi au cours de ces neuf décennies. Mais il s'agit de poursuivre cette tâche en allant plus loin, de contribuer à donner à la critique historique du prolétariat un contenu plus profond et plus concret. En ce sens, nous ne pouvons pas permettre que ces matériaux continuent à circuler et à être discutés exclusivement «

 

en interne

 

» entre quelques camarades et groupes.


Au-delà de l'explication de notre méthodologie d'analyse, la présente contribution expose ce qui est pour nous l'

ABC

 de la révolution et de la contre-révolution dans la région espagnole des années 30, accompagné d'un bref compte-rendu critique du développement de la lutte des classes dans cette période, en soulignant la force du prolétariat, de son associationnisme, de ses tentatives insurrectionnelles. En même temps, nous avons essayé de montrer comment ce processus riche et complexe de la montée de la révolution était parallèle à la constitution et à l'établissement de son contraire : la contre-révolution. En effet, nous avons montré comment, tandis que le prolétariat remettait en cause et attaquait l'ensemble de l'ordre social, tentant d'imposer ses besoins par sa force collective, essayant de faire un saut qualitatif par des tentatives insurrectionnelles, la contre-révolution prenait des formes alternatives pour neutraliser et phagocyter cette force qui menaçait son existence : république, partis de gauche, «

 

alliances ouvrières

 

»… jusqu'à ce qu'elle trouve dans le Front populaire et l'antifascisme la formule sur laquelle la contre-révolution s'est structurée et imposée.


Avec cette contribution, nous considérons que nous avons fait un pas en avant dans l'analyse des fondements de la contre-révolution dans la question espagnole. Il va sans dire que nous encourageons les camarades à nous envoyer toute critique de ce bilan, ainsi que toute information peu connue relative à ce formidable épisode de notre lutte de …

title: Goûter de rentrée de l'anticra le 16/09 à 17h30
content:
Les centres de rétention adminstrative (

CRA

) sont des prisons où l'Etat enferme les personne qu'il considère comme «

 

sans papiers

 

». Les

CRA

 sont un maillon clé de la politique coloniale et raciste menée contre les personnes étrangèr.e.s. S'ils doivent théoriquement servir à organiser l'expulsion des prisonnier.es, ils sont en réalité toujours davantage utilisés pour enfermer celleux que l'Etat considère comme indésirables. En témoigne la durée d'enfermement maximale qui n'a cessé d'augmenter, passant de 48h à leur création à 90 jours en 2018 et même 210 jours pour certain.e.s depuis la loi Rodwell adpotée l'été dernier. A Lyon, il y a deux

CRA

 près de l'aéroport Saint Exupéry. Les conditions d'enfermement y sont ignobles (violences policères permanentes, nourriture insuffisante, ignoble et périmée, ...).

CRA

, de dénoncer les entreprises qui collaborent avec les

CRA

, de lutter contre les nouvelles constructions et plus généralement de lutter pour la fermeture de tous les

CRA

.


Mercredi, on présentera un peu plus les

CRA

 et le collectif et on parlera de l'actualité dans les

author: Unknown
title: Ses kaydı iddiasıyla gündeme gelmişti: AKP Kilis İl Başkanı istifa etti
content:
AKP Kilis İl Başkanı Zihni Serhan Diyarbakırlı, kendisine ait olduğu öne sürülen ses kaydının sosyal medyada yayımlanmasının ardından görevinden istifa etti. Kaydın montajlandığını ve bağlamından koparıldığını savunan Diyarbakırlı, iddialara ilişkin hukuki süreç başlattığını açıkladı.

Sosyal medyada yayılan yaklaşık 6 dakikalık ses kaydının AKP Kilis İl Başkanı Zihni Serhan Diyarbakırlı’ya ait olduğu belirtildi. Kayıtta, görev yeri değiştirilen bir kadının eski görev yerine dönme talebine ilişkin bir görüşmenin yer aldığı iddia edildi.

Tartışmaların ardından yazılı açıklama yapan Diyarbakırlı, AKP Kilis İl Başkanlığı görevinden kendi isteğiyle ayrıldığını duyurdu.

Diyarbakırlı, açıklamasında kendisini hedef alan ses kaydının “montaj” olduğunu savunarak, içerikle ilgili hukuki süreci başlattığını belirtti.

“Son günlerde şahsımı hedef alan montaj ses kaydı ve buna bağlı olarak ortaya atılan iddiaları yakından takip ediyorum. Söz konusu içeriklerle ilgili gerekli hukuki süreç tarafımca başlatılmış olup, gerçeklerin hukuk önünde tüm açıklığıyla ortaya çıkacağına olan inancım tamdır” diyen Diyarbakırlı, siyasi teşkilatın tartışmanın tarafı haline gelmesini istemediğini ifade etti.

Bu nedenle AKP Kilis İl Başkanlığı görevinden istifa ettiğini belirten Diyarbakırlı, "kararının teşkilatın itibarının korunması ve hukuki sürecin siyasi tartışmaların gölgesinde kalmaması amacıyla alındığını" kaydetti.

"İstifasının hakkındaki iddiaları kabul ettiği anlamına gelmediğini" vurgulayan Diyarbakırlı, şu ifadeleri kullandı:

“Bu kararım kesinlikle bir geri adım, kabulleniş veya hakkımdaki iddiaların doğruluğu anlamına gelmemektedir. Ben görevimden ayrılıyorum; ancak haklılığımdan, hukuk mücadelemden ve davamıza olan inancımdan ayrılmıyorum.”

Diyarbakırlı, ses kaydını hazırlayan, yayımlayan ve paylaşan kişiler hakkında da hukuki süreç başlatıldığını açıkladı.

“Kirli siyasete teslim olmayacağız. Algı operasyonlarına boyun eğmeyeceğiz. Yalan karşısında susmayacağız. İtibarımızı hedef alan hiçbir girişimi karşılıksız bırakmayacağız” ifadelerini kullandı.

Kilis’te sosyal medyada paylaşılan ses kaydında, görev yeri değiştirilen bir kadının hastanedeki eski görevine dönmek istediğine ilişkin konuşmaların bulunduğu ileri sürüldü.

Diyarbakırlı’ya ait olduğu iddia edilen kayıtta, kadına “Beni nasıl ikna edeceksin?” sorusunun yöneltildiği, kadının ise kendisini yüz yüze görüşerek ikna edeceğini söylediği öne sürüldü.

Diyarbakırlı, yaptığı ilk açıklamada ise ses kaydının “belli odaklar tarafından montajlandığını ve bağlamından koparıldığını” savundu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

Fotoğraf: Josue Isai Ramos Figueroa/Unsplash

İzmir merkezli İzmer İnşaat Sanayi Ticaret ve Turizm A.Ş. hakkında İzmir 3. Asliye Ticaret Mahkemesi tarafından iflas kararı verildi. Mahkeme kararının ardından şirketin alacaklıları için ek sıra cetveli hazırlandı.

Yaklaşık 35 yıldır faaliyet gösteren İzmer İnşaat Sanayi Ticaret ve Turizm A.Ş.’nin iflasına, İzmir 3. Asliye Ticaret Mahkemesi’nin 23 Ocak 2026 tarihli ve 2023/829 Esas sayılı kararıyla hükmedildi.

İflas kararının ardından hazırlanan ilan İzmir İflas Müdürlüğü tarafından yayımlandı. İlanda, şirketin borçları nedeniyle iflas masasına alacak kaydı yaptıranların kayıt, kabul, ret ve sıralarını gösteren 8 Eylül 2026 tarihli ek sıra cetvelinin İzmir İflas Müdürlüğü divanhanesine asıldığı belirtildi.

İlanda, sıra cetvelinde gösterilen alacakların esasına ilişkin itirazların en geç 15 gün içerisinde İzmir Asliye Ticaret Mahkemelerinde, alacağın sırasına ilişkin itirazların ise en geç 7 gün içerisinde İzmir İcra Hukuk Mahkemelerinde dava yoluyla yapılabileceği bildirildi.

İzmir İflas Müdürlüğü, duyurunun İcra ve İflas Kanunu’nun ilgili maddeleri kapsamında yapıldığını belirtti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Amanda Audi
title: Instituto de André Mendonça é alvo de representações para investigar irregularidades
content:
Parlamentares do PSOL acionaram órgãos de controle para investigar possíveis irregularidades em contratos sem licitação entre o poder público e o Instituto Iter, entidade privada ligada ao ministro do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF)

André Mendonça

. 


O Iter, do qual Mendonça fazia parte da sociedade, obteve ao menos 52 contratos sem licitação com órgãos públicos como prefeituras, governos estaduais e tribunais.

 O valor dos contratos chega a R$ 8,2 milhões em um intervalo de dois anos, como revelou apuração da

Revista Fórum

.


Políticos entraram com pedido para tribunais de conta e promotoria sobre contratos do Iter sem licitação


O maior acordo foi com o Tribunal de Justiça do Amazonas, no valor de R$ 1,6 milhão, por um curso de pós-graduação para servidores. O governo estadual paulista, de Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) teve o segundo maior contrato, com um montante parecido, de R$ 1,6 milhão. A prefeitura de São Paulo, de Ricardo Nunes (MDB), e o governo do Rio de Janeiro, na gestão de Cláudio Castro (PL), também contrataram o instituto sem licitação – o primeiro por R$ 380 mil e o segundo por R$ 518 mil.


As

representações

, protocoladas em 3 de setembro pela deputada federal Luciene Cavalcante, o deputado estadual Carlos Giannazi e o vereador paulistano Celso Giannazi, foram direcionadas ao Tribunal de Contas do Município (TCM-SP), ao Tribunal de Contas do Estado (TCE-SP) e à Promotoria de Justiça do Patrimônio Público e Social de São Paulo.


Os parlamentares argumentam que a Lei de Licitações permite a inexigibilidade de concorrência apenas em situações excepcionais, em que se comprove que o serviço a ser contratado não poderia ser disponibilizado por outros fornecedores.

Eles levantam a suspeita de que o prestígio de André Mendonça no STF pode ter sido usado como justificativa para driblar o processo licitatório e inflar preços.


A reportagem pediu resposta ao ministro André Mendonça através da assessoria de imprensa do STF. O espaço segue aberto.


O encontro do ministro com Vorcaro


O ministro usou a sede do Iter em São Paulo para se encontrar com o banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro em 14 de março de 2025, fora da agenda oficial, como revelou apuração do jornalista

Paulo Motoryn

. Mendonça disse que o motivo da reunião não foi a crise do banco Master, mas sim assuntos relacionados a precatórios. Ele deixou a sociedade no Iter um dia depois de o encontro vir

à tona

.


 Imagem enviada pelo advogado Ciro Rocha Soares a Daniel Vorcaro


As representações pedem que os órgãos de controle requisitem a íntegra dos processos de contratação do Iter, verifiquem a compatibilidade dos valores pagos em relação ao mercado e impeçam novos acordos.

author: Unknown
title: Eskişehir’den işçiler OVP’yi değerlendirdi: Birikim yapmak hayal, borçlar gerçek
content:
Eskişehir’de Beko’da çocuklarının okul masraflarını kara kara düşünen babanın, Hava İkmal’de ücret iyileştirmesinden umudu kalmayan kamu işçisinin, Şişecam’da borç yükü altında ezilen cam işçisinin ortaklaştığı nokta Orta Vadeli Programın işçilerin lehine olmaması. Eskişehirli işçilerin vurguladığı gibi, programın içeriği ne kadar süslü sözcüklerle anlatılırsa anlatılsın sonuç işçilerden kemer sıkmalarını istemeye varıyor.

Eskişehir- 2027-2029 dönemini kapsayacak olan Orta Vadeli Program geçtiğimiz hafta sonu açıklandı. Programda en çok öne çıkan “enflasyonla mücadele” söylemi oldu. Program incelendiğinde ise faturanın bir kez daha işçilere, emekçilere ve emeklilere kesildiği görüldü; vergi yükü artacak, bütçe açığı büyüyecek, ücretler baskılanacak, kamu harcamalarında da “tasarruflar” dönemi ağırlaşarak devam edecek. Eskişehir’de farklı sektörlerde çalışan işçiler Saray rejiminin ekonomi programını değerlendirdi. İşçiler ekonomik programın adını ya da içerisinde yer alan maddeleri tek tek bilmese de hükümetin işçiler lehine bir şey açıklamayacağını biliyor.

Bir Beko işçisi Orta vadeli programın yaşamında nereye denk geldiğini şöyle anlatıyor: “Okullar açılıyor. Bir çocuğum dershaneye diğeri liseye başlayacak. Bu yıl nasıl geçecek diye kara kara düşünüyoruz. Kırtasiye giderleri ateş pahası. Yoldu yemekti derken masraflar boyumuzu aşıyor. Çocukları okula yazdırınca, defterini, kitabını alınca masraflar bitmiyor ki, hatta yeni başlıyor. Her gün harçlık vermek gerekiyor. Eşim ve ben stresten geceleri uyuyamıyoruz. Bunları sadece biz yaşamıyoruz. Bunların sorumlusu da iktidardakiler. O nedenle onlardan işçilere hayırlı bir haber gelemeyeceğini artık öğrenmemiz gerek.”

Yıllardır insanca yaşanacak bir ücret talebi ile mücadele eden kamu işçileri de Orta Vadeli Programı eleştiriyor. Hava İkmal Fabrikasında çalışan bir kamu işçisi; “Bu program da önceki açıklanan programdan farksız. Enflasyonu düşüreceğiz diyorlar, 3 senedir düşmedi. Şimdi neden düşsün. Ne farkı olacak ki? Biz işçiler açısından bir fark yaratmayacağını görmemiz gerekir. Açıkça ücretlerde iyileştirme beklemeyin diyor AKP. Hem kendimizin hem de çocuklarımızın geleceği açısından kaygılıyız. En ufak bir birikim yapamıyoruz. Aldığımız ücretler geldiği gibi gidiyor. Kamu işçisi borç batağında yaşıyor.” diyor.

Şişecam fabrikasında çalışan bir işçi ise; “Borçlara yetişemiyoruz. Her şey ateş pahası. Bu program sayesinde işçinin belini bükmeye devam edecekler. İşçi, kredi borçlarıyla onların faizleriyle, vergilerle, resmen soyuluyor. Her ay bir önceki ayın borçlarını kapatmaya çalışıyoruz ancak kapatamıyoruz.” dedi.

İşçilerin anlattıkları saray iktidarının açıkladığı OVP’nin kimin çıkarına hizmet ettiği sorusuna da yanıt vermiş oluyor. Programın temel odak noktası olarak sunulan “fiyat istikrarı”, “enflasyonla mücadele” söylemleri, uygulamada işçilerin ücretlerini baskılamaya ve kapitalistlerin karlarını korumaya yarayacak.

Türkiye’de vergi yükünün büyük bir kısmı, gelir üzerinden değil, harcamalar üzerinden alınan KDV ve ÖTV gibi dolaylı vergilerle çalışanların sırtına yıkılmış durumda. Her alışverişte, her fatura ödemesinde emekçilerin bütçesinden iki kat fazla para çıkıyor. Enflasyonu düşüreceğiz diyerek ücret zamları hedeflenen enflasyona göre belirleniyor. Bu durumda işçilerin alım gücü her geçen gün daha da düşüyor. Kamu kaynakları ve teşvikler büyük sermaye gruplarına aktarılıyor. Gelir adaletsizliği büyüyor.

title: Suudi Arabistan, Husilerin vurduğu Doğu-Batı boru hattını kapattı
content:
Fotoğraf: Niboj74/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 4.0

Suudi Arabistan Enerji Bakanlığı, Yemen’de Husilerin ilerleyişinin ardından Doğu-Batı boru hattının tedbir amaçlı kapatıldığını duyurdu.

Konuya ilişkin açıklama, Suudi Arabistan Enerji Bakanlığının ABD merkezli X şirketinin sosyal medya platformundaki hesabından yapıldı. Enerji Bakanlığındaki bir kaynağa dayandırılan açıklamada, Riyad-Medine bölgesindeki Doğu-Batı boru hattının 10 Eylül'de bir dizi saldırıya uğradığı belirtildi.

Saldırılar sonucu yaralanmalar olduğu kaydedilen açıklamada, boru hattının tedbir amaçlı kapatıldığı bilgisi paylaşıldı.

Acil durum ve uzman teknik ekiplerin, saldırıların ardından hattın güvenliğini sağlamak için gerekli çalışmaları başlattığı aktarıldı.

Husilerin Askeri Sözcüsü Yahya Seri, daha önce yaptığı açıklamada, bölgedeki Suudi Arabistan gemilerine karşı "ablukaya ablukayla, saldırıya saldırıyla" karşılık vereceklerini, Suudi Arabistan'a ait 32 savaş uçağını hedef aldıklarını ve bunlardan 9'unu düşürdüklerini belirtmişti.
